eats.name: Big Ed's Pizza
eats.what_to_order: Pizza and calzones, made from scratch and hand tossed per the restaurant's site; it also lists beignets.
eats.why: Open since 1961 and family-owned since 1969, still cooking in original 1960s gas ovens, per its own site.
eats.hours_note: Closed Mondays. Tuesday-Thursday 11am-10pm, Friday-Saturday 11am-11pm, Sunday 11am-10pm (own site).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and online ordering for its single Huntsville location, and Hville Blast's guide (last updated 2025-02-21) lists it as open with the same hours; the venue's own page shows no year (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: The Bakehouse Downtown
eats.what_to_order: The Figgy sandwich (smoked turkey, sharp white cheddar, fig jam on whole grain bread), per Alabama Living; croissants and fresh-baked pastries are also mentioned.
eats.why: A small downtown Fort Payne cafe-bakery on First Street West that opened in 2022, per Alabama Living.
eats.hours_note: Alabama Living says Thursday evenings feature a single-dish dinner on a rotating menu; check the cafe's social media for dates. The article gives no daily hours.
eats.open_evidence: Alabama Living Magazine feature published 2025-10-30 says the owner returned to teaching in 2025 while continuing to own and oversee the cafe (viewed 2026-10-15); no official website was found.

eats.name: Meal & Market
eats.what_to_order: Breakfast until 10:30 then lunch; the site names seasonal sides such as blackeyed peas and collard greens and says fries and chips are fried in tallow.
eats.why: A farmer-, veteran- and family-owned restaurant and market at 113 1st St W in downtown Fort Payne that sources locally, per its own site.
eats.hours_note: Own site: Monday-Friday 6am-2pm, Saturday 7am-2pm (all-day brunch menu Saturdays). Visit Lookout Mountain lists different hours, so call 256-465-7005 to confirm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists this week's seasonal sides, online ordering and e-gift cards; the page shows no year (viewed 2026-10-15), so this is weaker evidence than a dated page.

eats.name: Pizza Grace
eats.what_to_order: Sourdough pizza and beef tallow potatoes, per BhamNow's October 2024 James Beard trail article; the restaurant's own site lists food, wine and dessert menus.
eats.why: A Morris Ave pizzeria in Birmingham whose own site cites a 2025 Michelin Bib Gourmand designation.
eats.hours_note: Closed Mondays; Sunday 11am-9pm; open until 10pm Friday and Saturday (own site). Other weekday hours were not stated on the page fetched.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours at 2212 Morris Ave Suite 105 and online ordering, and refers to a 2025 designation, so it was updated in 2025 or later (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: The Bright Star
eats.what_to_order: Greek-style snapper and Greek-style steak, the signature dishes named by the Greater Birmingham CVB.
eats.why: In Bessemer, which the restaurant's own site places midway between Birmingham and Tuscaloosa, not in Birmingham itself. It calls itself the oldest family-owned restaurant in Alabama, serving Southern and Greek cooking.
eats.hours_note: Own site (fetched) does not list hours. Greater Birmingham CVB lists Sunday-Wednesday 11am-9pm and Thursday-Saturday 11am-10pm on an undated page; other directories differ, so call (205) 424-9444 before driving.
eats.open_evidence: Own website footer reads 2026 and offers online ordering, rewards and reservations; BhamNow (2025-03-13) also reports it remains actively operating (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Doc's Seafood Shack & Oyster Bar
eats.what_to_order: Seafood and oysters, per the group's locations page.
eats.why: In neighbouring Orange Beach (26029 Canal Rd) rather than Gulf Shores itself. A local three-restaurant seafood group that says it has operated for over 34 years.
eats.hours_note: Own site lists 11am-9pm daily at all three locations. The pages fetched mention no hurricane closure notice.
eats.open_evidence: Own website footer reads 2026 and lists current hours and phone numbers for all three locations (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: The Hangout
eats.what_to_order: Seafood boils with shrimp and crab legs, the Lifeguard Burger and crispy calamari, per its own site.
eats.why: A beachfront restaurant with direct beach access and free live music hourly, per its own site; it has two locations (Gulf Shores and Myrtle Beach).
eats.hours_note: Own site says open daily in Gulf Shores but states no hours. The page fetched mentions no hurricane closure notice.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists upcoming events including Halloween (Oct 30-31), Battle of the Bands (Nov 22, 2026) and an all-you-can-eat Thanksgiving dinner (Nov 26, 2026) (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Callaghan's Irish Social Club
eats.what_to_order: Burgers; the menu lists a Conecuh Burger as the Thursday special, plus a Shrimp Po'boy and Bread Pudding with Irish Whiskey Sauce.
eats.why: A single-location neighbourhood bar and grill that has operated since 1946 in Mobile's Oakleigh Garden District, per its own site.
eats.hours_note: Monday-Saturday 11am-11pm, Sunday 10am-11pm (own site); menu shows no prices.
eats.open_evidence: Own website footer reads 2026 and lists current hours and a full menu (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Panini Pete's
eats.what_to_order: The Muffaletta panini, beignets and the House Roasted Turkey, all named on the menu page.
eats.why: Its own site says the Muffaletta panini was featured on the "100 Things to Eat in Alabama Before You Die" list.
eats.open_evidence: Own website and menu page footers read 2026 and the menu page lists current breakfast, lunch and drink menus (viewed 2026-10-15); hours were not on the pages fetched.

eats.name: The Fairhope Inn
eats.what_to_order: Hand cut steaks and Alabama Gulf seafood, with New Orleans-inspired dishes, per its own site.
eats.why: A single-location restaurant and bed-and-breakfast at 63 South Church Street in Fairhope.
eats.hours_note: Own site lists Thursday-Saturday lunch 11am-2pm and dinner 5pm-10pm, and Sunday brunch 10am-2pm; no hours were shown for Monday-Wednesday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website carries 2026-dated posts, a Thanksgiving reservations promotion and dated October events (viewed 2026-10-15); the footer itself shows no year.

eats.name: Fire Island Rustic Bakeshop
eats.what_to_order: The site lists sourdough and artisan breads, croissants, scones, muffins, cookies, tarts and sandwiches.
eats.why: A local bakery whose own site says it is a 2026 James Beard finalist in the Outstanding Bakery category, with a downtown shop on K Street.
eats.hours_note: Site lists the K Street and Airport Heights bakeshops open Wednesday-Sunday 7am-4pm (closed Monday and Tuesday); the Little Sister Espresso counter is listed open 7 days, 7am-4pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website (fireislandbread.com) lists current hours for its K Street (718 K St) and Airport Heights (2520 E 16th Ave) shops and announces the 2026 James Beard finalist nomination; the page footer reads 2022, but the 2026 announcement is newer (viewed 2026-10-15). Two bakeshops plus an espresso counter at the Airport Heights address.

eats.name: Sofra Turkish Cuisine
eats.what_to_order: Anchorage Daily News names the serpme kahvalti shared Turkish breakfast spread and menemen (eggs with tomatoes and peppers).
eats.why: A Turkish breakfast-and-brunch spot in Spenard where the shared breakfast spread is the point; a 2026 opening rather than a long-running institution.
eats.hours_note: Own page lists Tuesday-Sunday 9am-2pm for breakfast/brunch, with the cafe menu available Tuesday-Friday only; the page shows no year.
eats.open_evidence: Own page (turkishdelightalaska.com/sofra) lists current hours at 1443 W Northern Lights Blvd but shows no year (it mentions a soft opening on April 24); Anchorage Daily News 'Open & Shut' of 2026-07-11 reports the restaurant recently opened at the same address with breakfast 9am-1pm (viewed 2026-10-15).
eats.source_name: Sofra's own page (with Anchorage Daily News, 2026-07-11)

eats.name: The Highliner
eats.what_to_order: The site lists halibut, wild Alaskan salmon, king crab, and fish & chips.
eats.why: A harbour-town seafood kitchen that, per its own site, stays open through the winter while much of Seward's visitor trade closes for the season.
eats.hours_note: Site says open daily for lunch and dinner, year-round; specific opening times are not listed on the page.
eats.open_evidence: Own website (highlinerseward.com) shows a 'Copyright © 2026' footer, lists 303 Adams Street and a current menu, and states it stays open year-round; single location, described as locally owned and operated (viewed 2026-10-15).

stops.note: The NPS says that in fall, winter and spring (roughly mid-September to mid-May) the nearest restaurants and convenience stores to Denali are in Healy, 11 miles north of the park entrance, and that the Morino Grill, the park's only sit-down restaurant, is seasonal (NPS page last updated 2023-11-15). Our advice: Healy is where meals happen on the Denali days; expect few open places this late in the year and carry food for the park.

eats.name: Denali Totem Inn restaurant
eats.what_to_order: The site lists burgers with hand-pressed patties, fresh-cut fries, pasta, pizzas, and Mediterranean items with house-made gyro loaf, sauces and pitas.
eats.why: In Healy, 11 miles north of the Denali park entrance rather than inside the park; the inn states it operates year-round, closing only Christmas and Thanksgiving.
eats.hours_note: Restaurant page lists open daily 12pm-9pm; closed Christmas and Thanksgiving. The site's homepage gives the facility as 9am-11pm daily.
eats.open_evidence: Own website (thetoteminn.com) lists current hours and a menu and mentions air conditioning 'newly added in 2025'; it states it operates year-round (viewed 2026-10-15). Only the 2025 mention dates the page; no 2026 footer.

eats.name: The Rookery Cafe
eats.what_to_order: The site mentions scratch-made bread, burgers, pickles and cured salmon, and Stumptown coffee.
eats.why: A downtown Juneau coffeehouse and bistro that, per its own site, makes its bread, pickles and cured salmon from scratch.
eats.hours_note: Site lists Monday-Friday 7am-2pm, Saturday 9am-2pm, closed Sunday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website (therookerycafe.com) shows '© 2026, The Rookery Cafe' and current hours at 111 Seward Street; single location (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: The Hangar on the Wharf
eats.what_to_order: The site highlights grilled halibut and fries and Alaskan king crab.
eats.why: A pub-restaurant in a 1932 airplane hangar on Juneau's Merchant's Wharf, serving there since 1996 per its own site.
eats.hours_note: Site lists Sunday-Thursday 11am-9pm and Friday-Saturday 11am-9:30pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website (hangaronthewharf.com) lists current hours and menu and marks '30 years of warm Alaskan hospitality' since 1996, i.e. 2026; single location at 2 Marine Way (viewed 2026-10-15). It shows no copyright footer.
eats.source_name: The Hangar on the Wharf's own website

eats.name: Sacred Grounds Cafe
eats.what_to_order: The site mentions fresh coffee, espresso, specialty drinks and baked goods.
eats.why: A Tlingit & Haida tribal-enterprise cafe in downtown Juneau for coffee and baked goods.
eats.hours_note: Site lists Monday-Friday 7am-5pm at 320 West Willoughby Ave; the second location at 219 S. Franklin St is marked 'CLOSED FOR THE SEASON'.
eats.open_evidence: Own website (sacredgroundsak.com) shows a 2026 copyright footer and current hours for the Willoughby Ave location (viewed 2026-10-15). Two locations, one closed for the season.

eats.name: Annabelle's Famous Keg and Chowder House
eats.what_to_order: The site lists red king crab, halibut fish and chips, Cajun crab cakes, seafood chowder and blackened halibut.
eats.why: A chowder house on Front Street in Ketchikan with king crab and halibut on the menu.
eats.hours_note: Site lists Tuesday-Friday 11am-8pm and Saturday 11am-10pm; closed Sunday and Monday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu at 326 Front Street and shows a '2026' copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-15). Single location; the page does not state ownership.

stops.note: The NPS dining page for Grand Canyon says that, due to the 2026 Bright Angel Creek flash flood and Stage 4 water restrictions, many restaurants are closed or have shortened hours until further notice, and it marks the Deli at the Marketplace and the Yavapai Dining Hall as closed. Tusayan, the gateway town 7 miles south of the park, has its own restaurants. Our advice: check the NPS page the morning of your visit, carry lunch on rim and trail days, and treat the Tusayan places below as the dependable fallback.

eats.name: Bright Angel Fountain
eats.what_to_order: Coffee, tea and breakfast in the morning, then ice cream and grab-and-go items in the afternoon, per the NPS listing.
eats.why: A canyon-side patio inside Bright Angel Lodge in Grand Canyon Village, handy for a quick bite before a rim walk or the Bright Angel Trail.
eats.hours_note: NPS lists it as open year-round at Bright Angel Lodge, with the park-wide warning that many restaurants are closed or on shortened hours; grandcanyonlodges.com says carry-out is available from the Fountain. No hours are stated on either page.
eats.open_evidence: NPS Grand Canyon dining page, which references the 2026 season, lists it as operating and not closed (viewed 2026-10-03); the lodging concessionaire's dining page also lists it, undated.
eats.source_name: National Park Service, Grand Canyon dining page

eats.name: Maswik Food Court and Pizza Pub
eats.what_to_order: The NPS page lists a food court and a pizza pub serving breakfast, lunch and dinner; the lodging concessionaire describes freshly baked pizzas and salads at the Pizza Pub.
eats.why: The casual, no-reservation option in the southwest corner of Grand Canyon Village at Maswik Lodge, when El Tovar is booked or you just want a quick meal.
eats.hours_note: NPS lists it as serving breakfast, lunch and dinner but warns that many restaurants are closed or on shortened hours until further notice; no hours are stated. grandcanyonlodges.com says the Food Court is open for dine-in (page undated).
eats.open_evidence: NPS Grand Canyon dining page, which references the 2026 season, lists it without a closure marker (viewed 2026-10-03); grandcanyonlodges.com lists it as open for dine-in, undated.
eats.source_name: National Park Service, Grand Canyon dining page

eats.name: Plaza Bonita
eats.what_to_order: Mexican plates across breakfast, lunch and dinner menus; the page lists entrees from about $19.99 at lunch to $30.99 at dinner but names no individual dishes.
eats.why: In Tusayan, 7 miles south of the park, not inside it; a sit-down Mexican restaurant with a breakfast menu, useful on a rim-day base.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows current breakfast, lunch and dinner menus with prices and online ordering; the footer shows 2025 and the page states no hours, so this is moderate evidence (viewed 2026-10-03). The NPS dining page also lists Plaza Bonita among Tusayan restaurants.

eats.name: Big E Spaghetti Western
eats.what_to_order: Pappardelle Elk Ragu, Big E Homestead Lasagna and Campfire Carbonara are named on the menu page; steaks include the Trail Boss Ribeye.
eats.why: In Tusayan, 7 miles south of the park, not inside it; an Italian-and-steak dinner stop with a full bar (the NPS page still lists it by its earlier name, Big-E Steakhouse, with the same phone number).
eats.hours_note: Own site says open daily 3PM to 9PM; it notes limited availability of the lasagna.
eats.open_evidence: Own website (bigesteakhouse.com redirects to bigespaghettiwestern.com) lists daily hours, a current priced menu and contact details; the page shows no year (viewed 2026-10-03). The NPS dining page lists Big-E Steakhouse at the same phone number.

eats.name: Big John's Texas BBQ
eats.what_to_order: Beef brisket, pork ribs, hot links or BBQ nachos, all named on the restaurant's site.
eats.why: A no-reservations barbecue stop in Page with live music nightly from 6:30 to 9 PM, per its own site.
eats.hours_note: Open 7 days a week 11 AM to 9 PM, first-come first-served with no reservations, per own site.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu with a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: The Dam Bar & Grille
eats.what_to_order: San Juan River Jambalaya, Honey Jalapeno Salmon, Prime Rib or a Top Sirloin, all listed with prices on its site.
eats.why: A Page dining room with a 30-foot etched glass wall and a scaled-down model of Glen Canyon Dam, per its own site; the Page Chamber of Commerce also lists it.
eats.hours_note: Own site says open 7 days a week, 11am to 11pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website (damplaza.com) lists daily hours and a current priced menu with a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-03); the Page Chamber of Commerce dining page also lists it, undated.

stops.note: The Navajo Nation Parks page for Monument Valley says the park offers limited food options: a restaurant at the visitor center is listed for summer months only, and Navajo vendors sell native food at roadside stands one mile before the visitor center. Our advice: do not count on eating inside the park in autumn or winter; plan meals in Kayenta, the nearest town with sit-down options I could verify, and carry water and snacks for the scenic drive.

eats.name: Amigo Cafe
eats.what_to_order: The cafe's site describes Mexican, Native American and American food and posts a breakfast menu and a coffee menu (as images).
eats.why: In the Navajo Nation town of Kayenta, not at Monument Valley itself; a family-run cafe that its own site says was established in 1983.
eats.hours_note: Open Tuesday to Saturday only, so closed Sunday and Monday. The cafe's home page says 8am to 8pm Tuesday-Saturday; its menu page says 10:30am to 8pm Tuesday-Friday and 8am to 8pm Saturday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and posts menu images labelled 2024; the pages show no copyright year, so this is moderate evidence (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Coffee Pot Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: One of its 101 omelette combinations, or huevos rancheros, biscuits and gravy or pancakes, all named on its site.
eats.why: A West Sedona breakfast stop on the route toward Oak Creek Canyon, serving breakfast all day.
eats.hours_note: Open seven days a week, 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, breakfast all day with lunch from 11:00 AM, per own site.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu with a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Indian Gardens Cafe & Market
eats.what_to_order: The breakfast burrito or the Dan the Man sandwich, both named in a Feb 2026 Sedona Lifestyles Magazine feature.
eats.why: A historic general store and cafe in Oak Creek Canyon, north of Uptown Sedona on State Route 89A, so it fits a day on the canyon's trails and swimming spots.
eats.hours_note: Open every day 8am to 4pm with the kitchen closing at 3pm, plus a Friday pizza night 4 to 8pm, per own site; the magazine feature puts most items between $11 and $17.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and a Friday pizza night (page shows no year); a Sedona Lifestyles Magazine feature dated 2026-02-08 describes the same hours and menu (viewed 2026-10-03).
eats.source_name: Venue's own website, with dishes per Sedona Lifestyles Magazine (2026-02-08)

eats.name: Mesa Grill
eats.what_to_order: Grilled steaks, fresh seafood or fish and chips with sidewinders; chilaquiles and biscuits and gravy are on the day menu.
eats.why: A full-service grill with a dinner menu from 3 PM, at 1185 Airport Rd in Sedona, a short way outside the Uptown area.
eats.hours_note: Own site says daily 7:30 AM to 9:00 PM, with breakfast, brunch and lunch to 3:00 PM and dinner from 3:00 PM; reservations by phone or OpenTable.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current daily hours and menu, takes reservations and shows no closure notice; the page shows no copyright year, so this is moderate evidence (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: The Fry Bread House
eats.what_to_order: Fry bread in its red chili, deluxe, chocolate and sugar versions; a second site mentions fry bread tacos.
eats.why: A Tohono O'odham-founded fry bread restaurant on N 7th Ave in central Phoenix that calls itself a James Beard Award winner; breads are made to order, so allow 10-15 minutes.
eats.hours_note: Open 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM Monday through Saturday and closed Sundays, per own site; bread is made to order and takes 10-15 minutes.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and a made-to-order notice; a second official site, azfrybreadhouse.com, cites New Times Best of Phoenix awards for 2022 to 2024; neither page shows a copyright year (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: FnB
eats.what_to_order: The homepage names no dishes; the menu is on the restaurant's own site.
eats.why: A full-service restaurant on 5th Ave in Old Town Scottsdale, and the dinner named in the itinerary; reservations are taken through Tock.
eats.hours_note: Full-service dining 5 p.m. to 10 p.m. Tuesday through Saturday, per own site, so closed Sunday and Monday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current dining hours and a reservation link with a footer reading 2015-2026 (viewed 2026-10-03).

stops.note: Tucson Foodie reported on 2026-09-30 that Agustin Kitchen at Mercado San Agustin closed permanently, and that Presta Coffee Roasters, Seis Kitchen and La Estrella Bakery remain open in the courtyard. Our advice: the itinerary's Mercado San Agustin lunch still works, but pick one of the open tenants and check hours first.

eats.name: El Güero Canelo
eats.what_to_order: A Sonoran hot dog or carne asada, which its site calls its famous items, plus tacos, burritos and tortas.
eats.why: A Tucson Sonoran-hot-dog institution since 1993 with three Tucson branches, so one is usually on your way.
eats.hours_note: Own site lists 11 AM to 10 PM Sunday-Thursday and 11 AM to 11 PM Friday-Saturday, with slightly different closing times at some branches.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists three current Tucson locations with hours and online ordering, and mentions James Beard recognition; the page shows no copyright year (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: El Charro Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Chimichanga, tamales, enchiladas or carne seca, all named on its site.
eats.why: Its site says it is the nation's oldest Mexican restaurant in continuous operation by the same family, founded in 1922; the downtown branch is at 311 N Court Ave.
eats.hours_note: Downtown branch lists Monday to Sunday 11:00am to 9:00pm, per own site.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current locations and the downtown hours, but its footer shows only 2023, so the year evidence is weak; Visit Tucson's downtown dining page also lists it, undated (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Cup Cafe
eats.what_to_order: The dessert carousel, a display of house-made sweets that the hotel's site highlights.
eats.why: Inside the historic Hotel Congress, open since 1990 per the hotel's site, so it suits a downtown stop in the evening or at brunch.
eats.hours_note: Open Monday to Sunday 8 AM to 9 PM and closed 2 to 4 PM daily; reservations are accepted for breakfast and lunch Monday-Thursday only, per own site.
eats.open_evidence: Hotel Congress's own page lists current hours and reservation rules with a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-03); Visit Tucson's downtown dining page also lists it.

eats.name: Seis Kitchen
eats.what_to_order: The source names no menu items.
eats.why: A courtyard business at Mercado San Agustin, the market the itinerary names for lunch, reported by Tucson Foodie on 2026-09-30 as still open after a neighbouring restaurant closed.
eats.open_evidence: Tucson Foodie article dated 2026-09-30 lists Seis Kitchen among the Mercado San Agustin courtyard businesses that remain open (viewed 2026-10-03); its own site returned 403 to my fetch, so no hours were seen.

eats.name: Tusk & Trotter
eats.what_to_order: The weekday lunch menu on its site names an Ozark Cobb Salad and a craft bison burger called 'Where the Buffalo Roam'.
eats.why: A locally owned two-location restaurant (Bentonville and Rogers) at 110 SE A Street in downtown Bentonville, open for lunch through dinner every day.
eats.hours_note: Per its own site: Mon-Fri 11 am-9 pm, Sat-Sun 10 am-9 pm; weekday lunch menu Mon-Fri 11 am-5 pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, weekday lunch and happy-hour details and carries a photo file named for March 2026 (viewed 2026-10-15); the footer text reads Copyright 2024.

eats.name: Local Flavor Cafe
eats.what_to_order: The site describes fresh and creative dishes for lunch, dinner and Sunday brunch; it names no specific dish.
eats.why: Locally run restaurant and wine bar at 71 S. Main Street in downtown Eureka Springs, serving lunch, dinner and a Sunday brunch.
eats.hours_note: New hours as of March 10, 2026 per its site: Tue-Sat lunch 11 am-3 pm; Tue-Thu dinner 5-9 pm; Fri-Sat dinner 5-10 pm; Sun brunch 10 am-2 pm; closed Monday. The site says to call for reservations.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer and a notice of new hours effective March 10, 2026 (viewed 2026-10-15).

stops.note: The National Park Service says the only restaurant inside Buffalo National River's boundary is the Buffalo Point concession in the Lower District, open from Memorial Day to Labor Day, and that canoe concessioners sell snacks, prepared food and groceries. Our advice: that restaurant is out of season now (mid-October), so plan meals in Jasper and carry a lunch on trail days (Whitaker Point, Hemmed-In Hollow).

eats.name: Low Gap Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Its ordering page lists the cuisine as American (Traditional) Italian and names no specific dish.
eats.why: A chef-owned restaurant that moved from a former gas station on Highway 74 into Jasper itself in September 2023, per the Arkansas Times.
eats.hours_note: Per its own ordering page: Wed-Thu 11 am-7 pm, Fri-Sat 11 am-8 pm, closed Sun-Tue; takeout, no reservations. Another listing gives different Sunday hours, so call (870) 861-5848 before going.
eats.open_evidence: Own ordering page showed 'Currently Open' with Thursday 11 am-7 pm hours when fetched on 2026-10-15; the page carries no year and the Arkansas Times relocation report is from September 2023, so this is weaker evidence than a dated page.

eats.name: The Pancake Shop
eats.what_to_order: Pancakes and egg plates, per its own site; the Hot Springs tourism listing adds fresh-squeezed orange juice and homemade sausage.
eats.why: Family-owned and serving breakfast only since 1940 at 216 Central Avenue, in the historic downtown across from the bathhouses.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 7 am-1 pm; no reservations, first come first served; the tourism listing says weekend mornings often have a wait.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer, daily 7 am-1 pm hours and a parking guide (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: McClard's Bar-B-Q
eats.what_to_order: The Sentinel-Record names dry rub ribs and brisket tacos as staff favorites, alongside the house barbecue sauce, baked beans and tamale spread.
eats.why: At 505 Albert Pike Road since 1942 (business dates to 1928); passed from the McClard family to local restaurateur Lee Beasley in 2020, per the Sentinel-Record.
eats.open_evidence: Hot Springs Sentinel-Record 'EAT Hot Springs' feature dated 2026-09-04 profiles it as operating, quoting its current general manager; the Hot Springs tourism blog dated 2025-07-09 also says it is open (both viewed 2026-10-15). Hours were not stated on any page I fetched.

eats.name: Cafe 1217
eats.what_to_order: The Sentinel-Record's feature listing describes salads, sandwiches and pastries, and the site says the chef-driven menu changes on the first Monday of each month.
eats.why: A dine-in cafe and gourmet-to-go shop at 1217 Malvern Avenue, a lunch option away from the bathhouse-row breakfast crowd.
eats.hours_note: Per its own site: Mon-Fri 11 am-6 pm, Sat 11 am-4 pm, closed Sunday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and a monthly-rotating menu with a 2025 copyright footer; the Hot Springs Sentinel-Record 'EAT Hot Springs' archive lists a Cafe 1217 feature dated 2026-07-24 (listing page only; viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Cotham's in the City
eats.what_to_order: The Hubcap Burger family (the menu lists a quadruple hubcap), a daily special such as fried chicken on Thursday, and Mississippi mud or a fried pie for dessert.
eats.why: The city location at 1401 W 3rd Street opened in October 1999 and carries on Cotham's Mercantile (1912, Scott), whose original building burned in May 2017, per its own site.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer and a current menu with prices and weekday daily specials (viewed 2026-10-15); the footer is on a site builder and may update automatically, and no page I fetched states hours.

eats.name: Degnan's Kitchen
eats.what_to_order: The Yosemite Hospitality page lists deli sandwiches, artisan pizzas, breakfast favorites, coffee and espresso drinks and baked goods.
eats.why: A quick breakfast or trail-lunch stop in Yosemite Village, close to the Valley visitor facilities, with indoor seating and an outdoor deck.
eats.hours_note: Per travelyosemite.com (no year shown): breakfast daily 7-11am, lunch daily 11:30am-6pm, limited service 11-11:30am. The NPS lists it as year-round.
eats.open_evidence: NPS Yosemite dining page, dated June 1, 2026, lists it among Valley options open year-round (the page calls it Degnan's Bakery); the concessioner's yosemite.com page carries a 2026 copyright (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Base Camp Eatery
eats.what_to_order: The NPS describes a food court with a variety of breakfast, lunch and dinner selections; it does not name dishes.
eats.why: The year-round food court at Yosemite Valley Lodge, handy for a flexible meal near the Yosemite Falls end of the Valley when you are between trails.
eats.open_evidence: NPS Yosemite dining page, dated June 1, 2026, lists it as a year-round food court at Yosemite Valley Lodge (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Mountain Room
eats.what_to_order: The NPS describes upscale casual dinner; it does not name dishes.
eats.why: The sit-down dinner option at Yosemite Valley Lodge for a post-hike meal without leaving the Valley.
eats.open_evidence: NPS Yosemite dining page, dated June 1, 2026, lists Mountain Room as year-round upscale casual dinner (viewed 2026-10-03). No restaurant-owned page was fetched.

stops.note: The NPS says Tioga Road is typically open to vehicles from late May or June until sometime in November and is closed to vehicles for the winter, and that services along it are limited (bring your own food and water). Mono County's tourism listing says Whoa Nellie Deli is open late April through early October. Our advice: do the Tioga Road day in summer or early autumn, and pack lunch for Tuolumne Meadows.

eats.name: Whoa Nellie Deli
eats.what_to_order: The deli's own site calls out its world-famous fish tacos; the Mono County listing also mentions sandwiches, pizza and desserts.
eats.why: A restaurant inside the Tioga Gas Mart at the junction of Tioga Pass (Hwy 120) and US 395, right at Yosemite's east entrance, with outdoor patio and live music twice weekly per the county listing.
eats.hours_note: SEASONAL. Mono County's tourism listing says open late April through early October, so it may already be closed or about to close for the winter. The site lists daily 6:30am-9:00pm in season. Call (760) 647-1088 before relying on it.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists daily hours 6:30am-9pm and marks its 30th anniversary (open since 1996, so 2026), with no closure notice (viewed 2026-10-03); the Mono County tourism listing gives the seasonal dates.
eats.source_name: Mono County Tourism listing (venue's own site also checked)

eats.name: Nicely's Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: The chamber page names homemade sausage, soups and classic fried chicken, plus daily specials and desserts.
eats.why: A full-service breakfast, lunch and dinner restaurant with a bar and patio at Highway 395 and Fourth Street in the middle of Lee Vining.
eats.hours_note: Chamber page lists daily 7am-8pm; no seasonal closure is stated on the page.
eats.open_evidence: Lee Vining Chamber of Commerce listing shows current hours and menu highlights, but the page carries no year, so this is weaker evidence; confirm hours before a late-season visit (viewed 2026-10-03).

stops.note: The NPS lists Grant Grove Village's food services as a restaurant and a market; no other dining is named on its Goods & Services page. Our advice: the village is where you sleep on both nights, so plan on these two plus anything you bring; pack lunch for Mist Falls and grove days.

eats.name: Grant Grove Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: The operator's page lists omelets, eggs, pancakes and burritos at breakfast, and salads, burgers, sandwiches and pizzas at lunch and dinner.
eats.why: The village's sit-down restaurant, overlooking Bradley Meadow and the giant sequoias, with a walk-up window for to-go items.
eats.hours_note: Operator page: breakfast 7-10am, lunch and dinner 11:30am-8pm daily; the courtyard walk-up window is seasonal.
eats.open_evidence: Operator's page (DNC Parks & Resorts at SEKI) carries a 2026 copyright and lists current hours and menu; NPS Grant Grove Restaurant page updated December 18, 2025 (viewed 2026-10-03).
eats.source_name: DNC Parks & Resorts at SEKI (park concessioner)

eats.name: Grant Grove Market
eats.what_to_order: The NPS describes a small supermarket selling basic groceries, beer, wine and camping supplies, useful for building a picnic.
eats.why: The only other food source in the village, for trail lunches and supplies when you are staying in the park.
eats.open_evidence: NPS Grant Grove page, last updated August 31, 2025, describes the market; no hours or 2026 confirmation were found, so check ahead (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Ferry Building Marketplace
eats.what_to_order: The site lists merchants including El Porteno Empanadas, Far West Fungi, Imperial Tea Court and Nopa Fish.
eats.why: An indoor food hall of nearly 50 local artisan food merchants right on the Embarcadero waterfront, which is on the Day 1 route.
eats.hours_note: Marketplace open daily 6am-10pm but individual merchants keep their own hours; closed Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. Farmers market year-round Tue and Thu 10am-2pm, Sat 8am-2pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website carries a 2026 copyright and lists current hours and merchants, with no closure notice (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: La Palma Mexicatessen
eats.what_to_order: The site lists carnitas, chicharron, chile verde, chile colorado and pollo en salsa ranchera, plus handmade tortillas and tamales.
eats.why: A Mission District tortilla factory and take-out counter at 2884 24th Street, founded in 1953 per its site, matching the Day 2 Mission taqueria plan.
eats.hours_note: Site says closed Tuesdays and open daily in December; standard hours 8am-5pm. Outdoor seating weather permitting.
eats.open_evidence: Own website carries a 2026 copyright and lists current hours and holiday closures (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Mandalay
eats.what_to_order: James Beard Foundation notes tea leaf salad prepared tableside, samusa soup and the Mandalay special noodle in coconut broth.
eats.why: A Burmese restaurant in the Richmond District (4348 California St, a short ride from Golden Gate Park) that has operated since 1984.
eats.hours_note: Own site: Mon and Wed-Thu 4:30-8:30pm; Fri-Sun 11:30am-3pm and 4:30-8:30pm; closed Tuesdays.
eats.open_evidence: James Beard Foundation announced it as a 2024 America's Classics winner, and its own website currently lists hours with no closure notice, though the page shows no year (viewed 2026-10-03).
eats.source_name: James Beard Foundation (restaurant's own site mandalaysf.com also checked)

eats.name: Oxbow Public Market
eats.what_to_order: The market's site lists vendors including Hog Island Oyster Bar, Ritual Coffee Roasters, Live Fire Pizza, Loveski Deli, Fieldwork Brewing Company, Roman Holiday Gelato and Johnny Doughnuts.
eats.why: The downtown Napa food hall on this itinerary's Day 3, with 20 vendors at 610 and 644 First Street, so a group can each eat something different.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 7:30am-9pm per the market's site; individual vendors may keep different hours.
eats.open_evidence: Own website carries a 2026 copyright and lists current hours and its 20 vendors (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Gillwoods Cafe
eats.what_to_order: The site mentions eggs Benedict and banana pecan pancakes.
eats.why: A breakfast and brunch cafe at 1313 Main Street, open since May 1991 per its site, that cooks from scratch.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: Tue-Wed 7am-2pm; Sun-Mon and Thu-Sat 7am-9pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and ordering links and says it opened May 1991, but the page shows no year; also listed in the City of St. Helena Dining Guide, which is undated (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Cafe Sarafornia
eats.what_to_order: The site mentions huevos rancheros, omelets and French toast.
eats.why: A family-run breakfast-and-lunch diner at 1413 Lincoln Avenue, operated by the Dierkhising family since 1976 per its site, within walking distance of downtown.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: Mon-Fri 8am-12:30pm; Sat-Sun 7:30am-2pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, online ordering and 45-plus years under the same family, but the page shows no explicit year (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Buster's Original Southern BBQ
eats.what_to_order: The homepage describes authentic Louisiana barbecue but lists no specific dishes.
eats.why: A Calistoga barbecue stop in business since 1965 per its own site, good for lunch before the Old Faithful Geyser and mud bath stops.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 10am-8pm per its site.
eats.open_evidence: Own website carries a 2026 copyright and lists current hours and online ordering (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Calistoga Inn Restaurant & Brewery
eats.what_to_order: The site gives no dishes; it describes a restaurant, brewery and hotel at 1250 Lincoln Avenue.
eats.why: A casual restaurant and brewery in the middle of town, with breakfast, lunch, dinner and weekend brunch served.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: breakfast daily 9-11am; lunch 11am-4pm; dinner Sun-Thu 4-9pm, Fri-Sat 4-9:30pm; weekend brunch 9am-1pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and Resy booking, but the page shows no year (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Sam's No. 3
eats.what_to_order: The site highlights its pork green chili (made with Hatch, New Mexico chilies), breakfast burritos, pancakes, cheeseburgers and souvlaki.
eats.why: A Denver diner that the site says dates to 1927, with a green-chili-and-souvlaki menu of 100+ items that works for any meal of a road-trip day.
eats.hours_note: Three locations (Glendale, Downtown at 1500 Curtis St, Aurora). Per the site, Downtown is open 7am-2pm Mon-Tue and 7am until 8pm or later Wed-Sun; Glendale runs 7:30am-8:30pm Sun-Thu and to 9pm Fri-Sat. Check the site for the location you pick.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours for each location, online ordering, and recent posts dated 2026 (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Denver Central Market
eats.what_to_order: The page lists vendors including Vero (grain bowls, cortados), Izzio (gourmet pizza), Green Seed (salads), Tammens Fish Market and Temper Chocolates.
eats.why: A food hall at 2669 Larimer St in the RiNo Art District, so it fits the RiNo mural-walk day and lets a group order from several counters.
eats.hours_note: Food vendors Sun-Thu 8am-9pm, Fri-Sat 8am-11pm; Curio Bar hours differ. Individual vendors may keep their own hours.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current food-vendor hours and a named vendor lineup (viewed 2026-10-03); the page shows no clear year.

eats.name: Ratio Beerworks
eats.what_to_order: The page lists the taproom's beer; it does not name food at the RiNo taproom (food is named only for the separate Overland location).
eats.why: A RiNo taproom at 2920 Larimer St, and one of the two breweries the Denver itinerary names for day 2.
eats.hours_note: RiNo taproom hours per site: Mon-Wed 12pm-11pm, Thu-Fri 12pm-12am, Sat 11am-12am, Sun 11am-11pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current RiNo taproom hours seven days a week (viewed 2026-10-03); the page shows no year.

eats.name: Hop Alley
eats.what_to_order: Per Visit Denver, Shanghai rice cakes, beef chow fun and Beijing duck rolls; the venue's own page lists traditional Chinese menus including vegan and vegetarian.
eats.why: A RiNo Chinese restaurant, a good sit-down dinner after the day-2 mural and brewery walk.
eats.hours_note: Monday-Saturday 5-10pm, closed Sundays; reservations via OpenTable.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, a Chef's Counter residency, reservation and takeout ordering details, and 2025 award notices (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: The Golden Diner
eats.what_to_order: The site lists pancakes, omelets and scrambles, Braised Pork Benedict and the Colorado Loco Moco.
eats.why: A locally owned breakfast diner at 700 12th St, a few minutes' walk from Washington Avenue, before the Coors tour and Red Rocks.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 7am-2pm-ish per the site; closes at noon on Christmas Eve and all day Christmas Day.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists daily hours and a Christmas closure notice (viewed 2026-10-03); the page shows no year, only that it has served breakfast 'for the past 15 years'.

eats.name: Cafe 13
eats.what_to_order: The site lists all-day breakfast, lunch from 11am (sandwiches, salads and soups) and pastries baked daily.
eats.why: In the historic Armory building at 1301 Arapahoe St, one block west of Washington Avenue; it is open into the evening on Friday and Saturday.
eats.hours_note: Per the site: Mon-Thu 6:30am-3pm, Fri 6:30am-8pm, Sat 7:30am-8pm, Sun 7:30am-3pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, online ordering and a '2025' copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-03); Visit Golden also carries a listing.

eats.name: Golden City Brewery
eats.what_to_order: The page says a food truck is on site but does not name dishes; the brewery describes itself as Golden's original microbrewery.
eats.why: A Golden microbrewery that the site says has been pouring since 1993, a few blocks from the Colorado School of Mines.
eats.hours_note: Opens daily at 11am. The page states summer last-call times of 8:30pm Sun-Thu and 9:30pm Fri-Sat; no winter hours are stated, so check before a cold-season visit.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows hours, a food truck listing and a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Village Coffee Shop
eats.what_to_order: The site lists fluffy pancakes, a green chili smothered breakfast burrito, hand-crafted burgers and French toast.
eats.why: A small Boulder diner at 1605 Folsom St that the site says has served the town for over 55 years, with breakfast all day.
eats.hours_note: Open 7am-2pm daily per the site.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current daily hours and menu (viewed 2026-10-03); the page shows no year, so this is weaker evidence than a dated page.

eats.name: The Sink
eats.what_to_order: The site lists the Texas Onion Straw Burger, Portabella burger, Cowboy Reuben, pizzas and barbecue short ribs.
eats.why: A single-location Boulder bar-and-burger landmark at 1165 13th St that the site says dates to 1923, near Pearl Street and the University of Colorado campus.
eats.hours_note: Sun-Thu 11am-10pm, Fri-Sat 11am-11pm per the site.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, a menu and current weekly specials such as Pizza Tuesdays (viewed 2026-10-03); the page shows no year.

eats.name: Boulder Dushanbe Teahouse
eats.what_to_order: The site lists brunch, lunch, dinner, tea time and an Afternoon Tea & Dim Sum Tea service; it names no individual dishes on the homepage.
eats.why: A teahouse at 1770 13th St, with brunch on weekends and a tea service between lunch and dinner.
eats.hours_note: Mon-Fri lunch 11am-3pm, teatime 3-5pm, dinner 5-9pm; Sat-Sun brunch 8am-3pm. The page lists private-event closures on October 2, 4, 8, 10 and 24 (no year shown), so check the site for the date you plan to visit.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, upcoming private-event closure dates and a 'Copyright 2026' footer (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Silver Grill Cafe
eats.what_to_order: The site names its cinnamon rolls (with a rotating Roll of the Month), pancakes, hash browns, country fried steak, burgers and skillets.
eats.why: A single-location Old Town breakfast place at 218 Walnut St that describes itself as Fort Collins' oldest restaurant, open since 1933.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 7am-2pm per the site.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists daily hours and a 2025 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-03); Visit Fort Collins also featured it in an October 2024 dining roundup.

eats.name: UNION Bar & Soda Fountain
eats.what_to_order: The site lists a double-patty burger, Monte Cristo sandwiches, French toast, house-made sodas and shakes.
eats.why: A soda-fountain-style diner at 250 Jefferson St, a short walk from Old Town Square, with vegan and gluten-free options marked on the menu.
eats.hours_note: Mon-Fri 11am to close, Sat-Sun 10am to close per the site.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu with a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: CooperSmith's Pub & Brewing
eats.what_to_order: The site lists full dinners and patio dining with vegetarian options and regional specialties, alongside its house ales, lagers and stouts.
eats.why: An Old Town Square brewpub that the site says has operated since 1989, a walkable dinner after the New Belgium and Odell visits.
eats.hours_note: Brewpub Sun-Wed 11am-9pm, Thu-Sat 11am-10pm per the site; the separate billiards room opens at 3pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current brewpub hours and a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Mountainside Café
eats.what_to_order: Own site mentions an avocado BLT, an Italian sandwich, french toast with berries, burgers, salads, and homemade cookies and muffins.
eats.why: In the neighbouring town of Falls Village (251 Route 7 South) rather than Salisbury itself; a single-location farm-to-table cafe that provides a supportive work space for people in recovery, run by Mountainside Treatment Center.
eats.hours_note: Own site: open Wednesday-Sunday 7am-3pm; closed Monday and Tuesday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists hours, menu items and a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Patty's Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: Classic diner-style breakfast and lunch; Visit Litchfield describes a huge menu, and the restaurant's own site does not list dishes.
eats.why: On Bantam Road in Litchfield rather than on the Green; a hometown diner that has been serving since 1996 per its own site.
eats.hours_note: Own site lists Mon-Sat 6am-2pm and Sun 7am-12:30pm, but also lists Tuesday as closed; confirm by phone (860-567-3335) before driving.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows current hours and a 2025 copyright footer, with an update posted 3/26/25 (viewed 2026-10-15); no 2026 date on the page.

eats.name: Toast & Co.
eats.what_to_order: Breakfast sandwiches, smoothie bowls and specialty lattes; the site notes a seasonal pumpkin spice flavor for fall.
eats.why: A breakfast-and-lunch cafe on Commons Drive, a quick coffee stop before the Connecticut Wine Trail and farm-country drive; its owners also run a sister cafe in Torrington (two locations).
eats.hours_note: Own site lists Mon-Fri 6:30am-3pm and Sat-Sun 7am-3pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website carries a 2026 copyright footer, current hours, and a fall seasonal item (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: The Village Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: Per Visit Litchfield, comfort food such as meatloaf with mashed potatoes, rigatoni Bolognese and horseradish-crusted salmon.
eats.why: A New England pub-style tavern at 25 West Street on the Litchfield Green, with local craft beers and farm produce when seasonally available per its own site.
eats.hours_note: Own site lists Mon-Thu 11:30am-9pm, Fri-Sat 11:30am-9:30pm, Sun 11:30am-8pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and reservation details with a 2025 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-15); dishes come from the Visit Litchfield listing (viewed 2026-10-15), not the venue site.
eats.source_name: Venue's own website (dishes per Visit Litchfield)

eats.name: Kitchen Little
eats.what_to_order: Own site mentions lobster benedict, oversized buttermilk pancakes, omelettes, and sweet local Bomster scallops from the Stonington docks.
eats.why: A bistro-style breakfast spot inside the Mystic River Marina at 36 Quarry Rd, with indoor seating and a deck over the river; the owner is named on the site.
eats.hours_note: Own site: closed Tuesday; Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri 7:30am-1pm; Sat-Sun 6:30am-1pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website home and About pages carry page timestamps of 2026-10-06, current hours, and an accessibility statement last updated November 21, 2025 (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Mystic Diner and Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: The menu names a Mystic Mess, Hungry Man and Pigs in a Snuggie for breakfast, a Mystic Burger, a lobster roll, and house-made donuts.
eats.why: A big-menu diner at 253 Greenmanville Ave, a short drive from the Seaport, open late and serving breakfast through dinner.
eats.hours_note: Own site (hours 'effective 3/12/25'): Mon-Thu 7am-10pm, Fri-Sat 7am-11pm, Sun 7am-9pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own site Location/Hours page shows hours dated 'Effective 3/12/25' and a 2026 footer, plus a current priced menu (viewed 2026-10-15); the footer year may be auto-generated.

eats.name: Louis' Lunch
eats.what_to_order: The hamburger sandwich of fresh ground beef on white toast, with optional cheese, tomato and onion; no condiments are offered.
eats.why: A single-location, family-owned burger shop at 261 Crown Street whose own site dates it to 1895 and cooks on its original cast-iron grills.
eats.hours_note: Own site: Tue-Wed 12pm-8pm, Thu 12pm-11:30pm, Fri-Sat 12pm-12am, closed Sunday and Monday; closes the week after New Year's and all of August.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and a 2025 copyright footer with no closure notice (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Modern Apizza
eats.what_to_order: New Haven apizza baked in brick ovens at 700 degrees F per its own site; the New Haven Independent's Sept 2026 story mentions its charred-crust slices and a white mozzarella onion slice.
eats.why: A single-location apizza house at 874 State Street, one of the three names on the itinerary's apizza crawl.
eats.hours_note: Own site: closed Mondays; Tue-Sat 10:30am-10pm; Sun 3pm-10pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, gift cards and a merch shop (2024 copyright footer); the New Haven Independent reported on 2026-09-29 that owner Billy Pustari hosted a Parking Lot Pizza Party outside the restaurant (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Atticus Bookstore Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Baked goods, coffee and espresso drinks, and sandwiches, per the items its own site lists.
eats.why: A downtown bookstore-cafe at 1082 Chapel Street, handy for a Yale campus and art gallery day; the New Haven Independent reported its 50th anniversary in December 2025, with a second location (Atticus Market) in East Rock.
eats.hours_note: Own site: downtown cafe open daily 8am-7pm.
eats.open_evidence: New Haven Independent, 2025-12-15, covered a city celebration of Atticus's 50th anniversary at the 1082 Chapel St. cafe; own website lists current hours for both locations (no copyright year on the page); viewed 2026-10-15.

eats.name: Jessop's Tavern
eats.what_to_order: Delaware LIVE describes New Sweden Meatloaf, 'Hutspot' Dutch pot roast, fish and chips, shepherd's pie and oven-baked pot pies, with Oli Bolen apple cakes for dessert.
eats.why: A colonial-themed tavern at 114 Delaware Street in the historic district, in a building dating to 1674, serving English, Dutch, Swedish and Belgian-influenced dishes and over 300 Belgian bottled beers.
eats.hours_note: Per its own website (whose footer reads 2020): Monday-Thursday 11:30am-9pm, Friday-Saturday 11:30am-10pm, Sunday 11:30am-8pm.
eats.open_evidence: Delaware LIVE feature published 2026-10-08 describes the Day family's tavern and its current menu (viewed 2026-10-15); the tavern's own site is live but its footer year is 2020.

eats.name: The Rehoboth Diner
eats.what_to_order: The online menu is organised into breakfast burritos, omelettes, hot cakes and waffles, plus Philly steaks, hoagies and seafood for lunch and dinner.
eats.why: A full-service diner on Coastal Highway that serves all three meals from 7am, handy on the drive in or out of town.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: open 7am-10pm, 7 days a week.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows 'Copyright 2026', current hours and a full menu (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Crabby Dick's
eats.what_to_order: The site highlights the crabcake sandwich, steamed snow crab legs, Maryland crab soup and steamed blue crabs.
eats.why: A Coastal Highway crab house in Rehoboth Beach built around crab cakes, steam pots and its own Seaman Sauce.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: Sunday 11am-9pm, Monday and Thursday 12pm-9pm, Friday 12pm-10pm, Saturday 11am-10pm; closed Tuesday and Wednesday. The site states no season dates.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a '2026' copyright footer and current hours listing a single Rehoboth location (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Dover Hollywood Diner
eats.what_to_order: The online menu is organised into omelettes, Belgian waffles, from-the-griddle items, breakfast sandwiches and wraps, with burgers, seafood and stir-fry on the dinner side.
eats.why: A full-menu diner at 123 N DuPont Highway in Dover that opens at 6am, handy for an early start before the Dover museums.

eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a current holiday-party booking banner, online reservations and ordering, with site records updated 2026-05-11; the page shows no visible copyright year (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.open_evidence: Own website carries a 2026 copyright and lists current daily hours (viewed 2026-10-03).

Our advice: if you arrive before mid-October, look up other Old Town options and check their hours first.

eats.name: Blue Heaven
eats.what_to_order: The page we read names no dishes; it lists breakfast and lunch from 8am, a happy hour and a dinner service.
eats.why: A Key West restaurant at 729 Thomas St that serves breakfast and lunch on a first-come, first-served basis and takes limited dinner reservations.

eats.name: Gideon's Bakehouse (Disney Springs)

eats.open_evidence: Own website carries a 2026 copyright and lists current hours for both shops (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Café Tu Tu Tango
eats.what_to_order: Small plates such as Jamon Serrano Croquetas, Crispy Brussels Sprouts and Sesame Steak Skewers.
eats.why: A single-location tapas restaurant at 8625 International Drive that says it has operated for over 30 years, with live entertainment nightly and during brunch.
eats.hours_note: Own website lists Monday-Friday 11am-midnight, Saturday 10am-midnight, Sunday 10am-11pm; weekend brunch from 10am.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu (page shows no year); Orlando Weekly's feature on long-running restaurants, published July 2, 2026, lists it at 8625 International Drive (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Coconuts On The Beach
eats.what_to_order: Locally sourced seafood, grilled and seasoned, and its signature tropical cocktails.
eats.why: Oceanfront dining in Cocoa Beach with live local bands through the week, per its site.
eats.open_evidence: Own website carries a 2026 copyright, describes live bands and oceanfront dining, and offers online ordering and gift cards (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Florida's Seafood Bar & Grill
eats.what_to_order: Dynamite Shrimp, Shrimp Volcano or Snow Crab.

eats.hours_note: Own website lists Monday-Thursday 11:30am-9pm, Friday-Saturday 11:30am-9:30pm, Sunday noon-9pm; lunch service Monday-Saturday only, 11:30am-3pm.

eats.name: Dixie Crossroads

eats.hours_note: Own website lists 11am-9pm daily, closed Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve and Christmas Day.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists daily hours and online ordering (page shows no year); Florida Backroads Travel's page, last updated May 15, 2026, gives the same hours (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, holiday closures, online shop and pre-orders (viewed 2026-10-14); the pages show no year, so this is weaker evidence than a dated page.

eats.name: Captain Jack's Island Grill

eats.open_evidence: Own website gives the new Kahana address (4299 Lower Honoapiilani Rd), current hours and a 2026 copyright footer; Honolulu Magazine (August 11, 2026) also reports the reopening (both viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.what_to_order: Kalua pork, the BBQ chicken platter or pork ribs; the site also lists shrimp pasta.
eats.why: Local BBQ plates at 5305 Hana Hwy, but weekday lunch only, so time the drive.
eats.hours_note: Own site: Monday-Friday 11am-2:30pm; closed Saturday and Sunday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists hours, address, menu and a '2026 Braddah Hutts BBQ Grill' copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.what_to_order: Banana bread from the bakery or wood-fired pizza at the Bamboo Hale restaurant.

eats.hours_note: Own site: farm stand Saturday-Thursday 9am-5pm and Friday 9am-8pm; restaurant Saturday-Thursday 10:30am-4:30pm and Friday 10:30am-8pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists hours, addresses and phone numbers for the stand and restaurant (viewed 2026-10-14); the page shows no year, so this is weaker evidence than a dated page.

stops.note: The Stanley Chamber's dining guide (copyright 2026) tags each listing with the seasons it is open (fall, spring/summer, winter), and some listed places, such as Idaho Rocky Mountain Ranch, are tagged spring/summer only. Our advice: check the closing dates on each card below before you plan a meal here, because the three places we could confirm all end their season between 17 and 25 October 2026.

eats.name: Stanley Baking Company & Cafe
eats.what_to_order: The Stanley chamber's guide lists croissants and cinnamon rolls among the fresh-baked pastries; the bakery's own site lists breakfast, lunch and baked goods sections.
eats.why: A bakery-cafe on Wall Street in Stanley that describes itself as set amid the Sawtooth mountains and the Salmon river, open for breakfast and lunch.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 7am-2pm. Own site says 'Last day of the Season, Sunday 10/18' (the page shows no year; 18 October is a Sunday in 2026, and its FAQ says the season runs from the second week of May through the third week of October). Closed for the winter after that.
eats.open_evidence: Own website homepage shows hours and a 'Last day of the Season, Sunday 10/18' banner, and the Stanley Chamber's 2026 dining guide lists it as open in fall (both viewed 2026-10-14); the bakery's own pages carry no year.

eats.name: Sawtooth Hotel
eats.what_to_order: The hotel's page describes Northwest comfort food in a rustic setting and does not name dishes; the Stanley chamber's guide notes patio dining with vegan and gluten-free options.
eats.why: Dinner at a hotel on Ace of Diamonds Street, Stanley's main road, with a patio and live music per the chamber's guide.
eats.hours_note: Dinner Thursday-Monday 5-9pm. Own site says 'Last night of the Season, Saturday 10/17' (no year shown; 17 October is a Saturday in 2026, so this is three days after 2026-10-14). Chamber guide lists it as open fall and spring/summer only.
eats.open_evidence: Own website homepage lists dinner service Thursday-Monday 5-9pm and 'Last night of the Season, Saturday 10/17'; Stanley Chamber 2026 guide lists it as open in fall (both viewed 2026-10-14); the hotel's page shows no year.

eats.name: Stanley Supper Club
eats.what_to_order: No dishes are named on the venue's homepage; the Stanley chamber's guide describes it as elevated dining with James Beard-nominated cuisine.
eats.why: A dinner restaurant in Stanley's town square that, unlike the three-season places, has a published winter reopening in January 2027.
eats.hours_note: Fall hours Friday-Monday 5-9pm, closed Tuesday-Thursday. 'Sunday October 25th: Last Day of the Season', reopening for winter in early January 2027.
eats.open_evidence: Own website states fall hours, a last day of Sunday October 25th and a reopening in early January 2027, so it is tied to this season; Stanley Chamber 2026 guide also lists it (both viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Pioneer Saloon
eats.what_to_order: The James Beard Foundation's signature dishes, as reported by the Idaho Mountain Express, include the Jim Spud (baked potato with teriyaki beef and cheese), smoked Idaho trout and steamed artichoke; Visit Sun Valley lists steaks, prime rib, seafood and ribs.
eats.why: A 2025 James Beard America's Classics winner in a building that has served Ketchum since the 1940s, run by the same family since 1986.
eats.hours_note: Open daily; bar opens 3:30pm. The dining room opens at 4:30pm per the saloon's own site but 5pm per Visit Sun Valley's listing, so arrive after 5pm. Visit Sun Valley says no reservations are accepted.
eats.open_evidence: Idaho Mountain Express (28 Feb 2025) reports its 2025 James Beard America's Classics award; the saloon's own site and Visit Sun Valley's listing both show current daily hours (viewed 2026-10-14); neither listing page carries a year.

stops.note: Bruneau Dunes State Park's own page says only that its visitor center sells gifts, souvenirs, drinks and snacks, and lists no restaurant. Our advice: for the Bruneau Dunes day, eat in Boise before you drive out and carry lunch and dinner supplies.

eats.name: Bar Gernika
eats.what_to_order: The menu page lists the Lamb Grinder, Solomo, Lamb Stew, Croquetas and Tortilla de Patatas, with Basque Style Rice Pudding for dessert.
eats.why: Basque food on Boise's Basque Block, where the downtown association says it has operated for nearly two decades.

eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer, 'now open for dine in and take-out' and current hours, and its menu page lists dishes; the Downtown Boise Association (copyright 1987-2026) also lists it (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: The Basque Market
eats.what_to_order: Rotating daily pintxos, croquetas, and paella, which the site says is cooked on the patio on Wednesdays and Fridays at noon.
eats.why: A Basque restaurant and imported-goods market on the same block, where the paella is cooked outdoors on set days.
eats.hours_note: Tuesday-Saturday 11am-5pm, closed Sunday and Monday, holiday hours may differ. Paella Wednesday and Friday at noon and first Thursday of the month at 6pm; the Downtown Boise Association lists $10.99 a plate.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and a paella schedule with no year on the page; the Downtown Boise Association (site copyright 1987-2026) lists the same hours (both viewed 2026-10-14).

stops.note: The National Park Service says the monument at Hagerman Fossil Beds has no dining or lodging, and that visitor services there are extremely limited (page last updated 27 April 2022). Our advice: for the Hagerman Valley day, eat in Twin Falls before you drive out; we could not confirm a Hagerman restaurant is open this pass, so check a place's own page or phone before you go.

eats.name: Milner's Gate
eats.what_to_order: The menu page quotes diners praising the Brie and Fig Burger, Ultimate Prime Rib Sandwich and Biscuits and Gravy, and the site advertises a Sunday brunch and its own house brews.
eats.why: A downtown Twin Falls brewpub with a 10-barrel in-house brewery, serving lunch and dinner plus Sunday brunch.
eats.hours_note: Closed Monday. Tuesday-Saturday 11am-closing, Sunday brunch 9:30am-2pm. Closed July 4, New Year's Day and Christmas Day.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, a happy hour and a Sunday brunch menu (viewed 2026-10-14); the page shows no year, so this is weaker evidence than a dated page.

eats.why: A Chicago pan-pizza specialist known for its caramelized cheese crust, at 2207 N. Clybourn Ave in Lincoln Park, an easy stop between the river tour and the lakefront.

eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours for both locations, promotes reservations and online ordering, and carries a 2025 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Superdawg Drive-In
eats.what_to_order: The Superdawg, the Whoopskidawg, or the Superburger, with Superfries and a Supermalt.
eats.why: A car-hop drive-in on N. Milwaukee Avenue open since 1948, a different Chicago food tradition from deep dish.

eats.name: Starved Rock Lodge Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: Fried walleye, fried chicken, or steak with vegetables, as the lodge's own page lists as standouts.
eats.why: The historic lodge inside Starved Rock State Park, so no drive after a day on the canyon trails; the Veranda overlooks the Illinois River.
eats.hours_note: Per the lodge page: breakfast 8-10:30am Mon-Sat (Sunday breakfast buffet only 8-9:30am), lunch 11am-3pm Mon-Sat, Sunday brunch buffet 10:30am-3pm, dinner 5-9pm daily. Reservations recommended; call (815) 220-7321.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current dining hours and Thanksgiving 2026 holiday menus (viewed 2026-10-15); Shaw Local also lists it among Starved Rock Country restaurants in a 2026 article.

eats.name: Skoog's Pub & Grill
eats.what_to_order: The Skoog Burger or the wings; the menu also lists pork chops and Italian beef sandwiches.

eats.hours_note: Coffee + Bakery at 742 Congress St listed open 7 days a week 8am-1pm, with same-day online pickup ordering 7:45am-10:15am.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours at both locations and carries a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Duckfat
eats.what_to_order: Belgian-style frites, hand-punched and twice-fried in duck fat and served in cones.
eats.why: Portland's duck-fat frites spot at 43 Middle Street, operating since 2005 per its site.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 11AM-10PM; first come, first served.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current daily hours and both locations (viewed 2026-10-03); the page shows no year.

eats.name: Eventide Oyster Co.
eats.what_to_order: The Brown Butter Lobster Roll, plus oysters and the fish sandwich, all named on the site.
eats.why: The oyster bar the Portland itinerary builds its day-1 dinner around, on Middle Street in the Old Port.
eats.hours_note: Open 7 days a week 11am-11pm; first come, first served with limited reservations through Resy; diners are asked to limit their time to 2 hours.
eats.open_evidence: Own Portland page lists hours and says it is currently booking reservations within 2 weeks of today's date (viewed 2026-10-03).

stops.note: Only two Freeport places are verified here: a lobster pound whose season ends October 12, 2026 and a brewery taproom. Check dates before relying on the lobster pound in autumn.

eats.name: Harraseeket Lunch & Lobster Co.
eats.what_to_order: Lobster rolls, clams and Maine shrimp, with whoopie pies and pies for dessert, all named on the site.
eats.why: A family-run waterfront lobster pound and lunch counter in South Freeport, running since 1970 per its site, with indoor and outdoor seating.
eats.hours_note: Seasonal, May through October: Thursday-Tuesday 11:00am-4:00pm, closed Wednesdays; the site gives the last day of the season as Columbus Day 10/12/2026; cash only (ATM on site).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and states 'Last Day for Season: Columbus Day 10/12/2026' (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Maine Beer Company
eats.what_to_order: IPAs and pale ales, which the site says it is known for, plus seasonal releases such as Black Barn.
eats.why: Freeport's own brewery, founded in 2009, with a tasting room and bottle shop on US Route 1.
eats.hours_note: Tasting room open daily 11am-8pm Sun-Thurs and 11am-9pm Fri-Sat; bottle shop opens at 10am daily. The page gives no food policy.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current tasting room hours and carries a 2026 copyright notice (viewed 2026-10-03).

stops.note: Many Boothbay-area eateries are seasonal; the region's own dining directory tells visitors to check individual listings for hours and seasonal operation. Only two places that state year-round operation are verified here.

eats.name: Brady's
eats.what_to_order: Classic American cuisine; the page names no specific dishes.
eats.why: A Union Street restaurant that says it is open all year, handy when the harbor's seasonal places have closed.
eats.hours_note: Site says it is open all year; Monday closed, Tuesday-Saturday 11:30 AM-8:00 PM, Sunday 7:30 AM-4:00 PM.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and says 'open all year long' (viewed 2026-10-03); the page shows no year.

eats.name: Footbridge Brewery & BBQ
eats.what_to_order: Brisket sandwiches, burnt ends and steak pizza, with 20 beers on tap made from 90% Maine-grown ingredients.
eats.why: A Granary Way brewpub in the harbor area that states it operates year-round, with a pet-friendly patio.
eats.hours_note: Site lists open daily Noon-9PM and states it operates year-round.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists daily hours, says its menu was reworked over the summer, and lists an Oktoberfest event for 9/19 (viewed 2026-10-03); the page shows no year.

eats.name: Camden Deli
eats.what_to_order: Breakfast pancakes and omelets, or a Reuben, panini or seafood chowder for lunch, all named on the site.
eats.why: A Camden landmark on Main Street since 1985 per its site, with a rooftop deck overlooking the harbor.
eats.hours_note: Open 7 days a week 7am-6pm; online ordering 7am-5:30pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and an active online ordering system (viewed 2026-10-03); the page shows no year.

eats.name: Peter Ott's on the Water
eats.what_to_order: Fresh seafood with seasonal offerings; the page names no specific dishes.
eats.why: A harbor-front dinner spot at 16 Bayview Landing that suits the itinerary's harbor-front dinner.
eats.hours_note: Seasonal: site says open May-October, daily 11:30am-9:00pm; walk-ins welcome, reservations for groups of eight or more. Its sister Ott's Cafe is marked closed for the 2026 season. The exact October closing date is not stated.
eats.open_evidence: Own website says it is open for the 2026 season daily 11:30am-9:00pm and marks Ott's Cafe closed for 2026 (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Salt Wharf
eats.what_to_order: Oysters and hand-crafted cocktails, which the site mentions.
eats.why: A dockside bar-bistro on Camden harbor, opened in 2022, whose site describes year-round harborside dining and a rooftop patio.
eats.hours_note: Dining room Thursday-Monday 4-8 PM; rooftop/patio Friday-Monday 12-7 PM; closed Tuesday and Wednesday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current dining room and rooftop hours and describes year-round harborside dining (viewed 2026-10-03); the page shows no year other than its 2022 opening.

eats.name: Chick & Ruth's Delly
eats.what_to_order: The site lists breakfast, sandwiches, hot platters and colossal and jumbo lump crab cakes.
eats.why: An Annapolis institution that its own site dates to 1965, with breakfast through crab cakes under one roof.
eats.hours_note: Closing time listed as 10pm (11pm Fri/Sat) April-October and 9pm (11pm Fri/Sat) November-March; the page does not state opening hours or days open.
eats.open_evidence: Own website carries a '© Chick and Ruth's 2026' footer and a seasonal closing-time schedule (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Boatyard Bar & Grill
eats.what_to_order: The site lists crab cakes, raw bar, fish tacos, crab soups, lobster rolls and burgers.
eats.why: A single-location restaurant at 400 Fourth St. in Eastport, across the creek from downtown Annapolis, that markets itself on its crab cakes.
eats.hours_note: Per its site, hours from April 3, 2026: Mon-Thu 11am-11:30pm, Fri 11am-11:30pm, Sat 10am-11:30pm, Sun 9am-11:30pm (kitchen closes earlier, 10pm-11pm); closed Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists 2026 hours 'beginning April 3, 2026' and a current menu (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Faidley's Seafood
eats.what_to_order: The site lists Faidley's Famous Crabcakes, mini crab balls and prepared platters.
eats.why: A crab-cake counter at 119 N Paca St. (Paca Street entrance of Lexington Market), a short drive from the Inner Harbor.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: Mon-Thu 10am-5pm, Fri-Sat 10am-5:30pm, closed Sunday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows '© 2026 Faidley's Seafood', current hours and a priced menu (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Attman's Delicatessen
eats.what_to_order: The site mentions piled-high sandwiches, a corned beef sandwich and a potato knish.
eats.why: A Baltimore deli with its original location at 1019 E. Lombard St.; it has three locations in all (two in Baltimore, one in Potomac).
eats.open_evidence: Own website carries 'Copyright © 2026 Attman's Delicatessen' and lists its locations and menu; the pages fetched did not show hours (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Corah's Corner
eats.what_to_order: The site lists oysters on the half shell and baked, Elijah's Oyster Stew, a crabcake sandwich, shrimp & grits and a spicy fish sandwich.
eats.why: A single-location restaurant at 105 N Talbot St. serving local Eastern Shore oysters and seafood.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: 'We close for the season after the parade and reopen in March'; its 2026 calendar gives the parade as Saturday, December 12, 2026. Sunday brunch 11am-2pm is mentioned.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows '© 2026 Corah's Corner' and a 2026 event calendar (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Schmankerl Stube Bavarian Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: The sources mention pork shank, dumplings and spaetzle.
eats.why: A Bavarian restaurant at 58 S. Potomac St., downtown, with a single location and the same proprietor-chef since 2008 according to its own site.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: Wed-Thu 11am-9pm, Fri-Sat 11am-10pm, Sun 11am-9pm; closed Monday and Tuesday; closed July 4, Thanksgiving, Christmas Day and New Year's Day.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menus (no copyright year shown) and it is listed with matching hours in Mainstreet Hagerstown's directory, footer '© 2026' (viewed 2026-10-15).
eats.source_name: Venue's own website; Mainstreet Hagerstown directory

eats.name: Pine Lodge Steakhouse
eats.what_to_order: The site lists hand-cut steaks, slow-roasted prime rib, a jumbo crab cake and creamy crab soup.
eats.why: A steakhouse at 1520 Deep Creek Drive in McHenry that says it has operated since 2002.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: Mon-Tue 4pm-9pm, Wed-Thu 12pm-9pm, Fri-Sat 12pm-10pm, Sun 12pm-8pm; outside dining is available weather permitting.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows these hours and a menu, and an own-site article dated August 13, 2026 carries the same hours; the home page shows no copyright year (viewed 2026-10-15).
