eats.name: Neptune Oyster
eats.what_to_order: The Maine lobster roll, served hot with butter or cold with mayo, or oysters from the raw bar.
eats.why: A small raw bar at 63 Salem Street in the North End, known for its lobster roll.
eats.hours_note: Opens daily at 11:00 AM; walk-ins only, no reservations (per the restaurant's own site; the page shows no year).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu (viewed 2026-10-15; page shows no year); Boston Magazine's 2026-10-14 article on its Taste 2026 event (Nov 4, 2026) names Neptune Oyster as a participating restaurant.

eats.name: Modern Pastry Shop
eats.what_to_order: Cannoli, cheesecakes, pies, cookies, biscotti, macaroons or torrone.
eats.why: A North End pastry shop with one other location, in Medford.
eats.hours_note: North End shop: Sun-Thurs 7am-11pm, Fri-Sat 7am-midnight (per its own site).
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer, current hours and active ordering (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Pie in the Sky Bakery & Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Scratch-made pastries, house-roasted coffee, sandwiches, soups and pies.
eats.why: A single-location Woods Hole bakery at 10 Water Street that opens at 5am, early enough for a morning ferry day.
eats.hours_note: Open 7 days a week, 5am-8pm, 364 days a year (per its own site; woodshole.com lists a different closing time, so confirm).
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2024 copyright footer, current hours and active ordering (viewed 2026-10-15); woodshole.com's eat page (2026 copyright footer) also lists it.
eats.source_name: Pie in the Sky's own website

eats.name: Fanizzi's Restaurant by the Sea
eats.what_to_order: Fresh fish and chips, mustard nut crusted cod, cucumber-dill salmon, or parmigiana.
eats.why: A single-location restaurant at 539 Commercial Street that serves lunch and dinner year-round.
eats.hours_note: Lunch 11:30 AM-3:30 PM, early bird 4:15-5:30 PM, dinner from 4:15 PM; open year-round, closed Thanksgiving and Christmas (per its own site).
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer and current hours (viewed 2026-10-15); The Provincetown Independent's 2025-12-03 winter guide lists Fanizzi's as open daily.

eats.name: Brava
eats.what_to_order: Tapas-style plates such as patatas bravas and pimientos, handmade pizza, and cheese and charcuterie.
eats.why: A tapas and small-plates restaurant at 65 Church Street, open since 2012.
eats.hours_note: Tuesday-Saturday 5-9 pm (bar to 10 pm); closed Sunday and Monday (per its own site).
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2024 copyright footer and current hours (viewed 2026-10-15); Edible Berkshires' Summer 2026 guide (published 2026-06-23) lists Brava as year-round.

eats.name: Pizzeria Boema
eats.what_to_order: Woodfired Napoletana-style pizza.
eats.why: A single-location woodfired pizzeria at 84 Main Street in Lenox.
eats.hours_note: Closed Tuesday and Wednesday; Mon, Fri 4-9 PM; Thu 4-8:30 PM; Sat 12-9 PM; Sun 12-8:30 PM (per its own site, which flags 'new hours').
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer and a 'please note our new hours' notice (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Prairie Whale
eats.what_to_order: A weekly-changing seasonal menu of local-farm meat and produce under Chef Daniel Studwell.
eats.why: A family-run restaurant at 178 Main Street built around local farms.
eats.hours_note: Sun, Mon, Thu 5-9:30 pm; Fri and Sat 5-10 pm; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (per its own site).
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a menu for an 'October 8th' week and current hours but no year (viewed 2026-10-15); Edible Berkshires' Summer 2026 guide (published 2026-06-23) lists it.

eats.name: The Spring Street Market & Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Breakfast and lunch from its menu pages, with house-made baked goods, meats and cheeses.
eats.why: A single-location market and cafe at 66 Spring Street run by chef-owners Karen and Benoit Gosselin.
eats.hours_note: Tue-Sat 8AM-5PM (kitchen closes 4PM); Sun 9AM-3PM (kitchen closes 2:30PM); closed Monday (per its own site).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours (viewed 2026-10-15; page shows no year); Edible Berkshires' Summer 2026 guide (published 2026-06-23) says the owners have served breakfast and lunch for 10 years.
eats.source_name: The Spring Street Market & Cafe's own website

eats.name: Wild Oats Market
eats.what_to_order: The hot bar, salad bar, grab-n-go cooler or rotisserie chickens.
eats.why: A community-owned grocery at 320 Main Street with a hot bar, handy for picking up lunch.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 8am-8pm; salad bar 8am-6pm, hot bar 8am-2pm, rotisserie chickens 3-6pm while available (per its own site).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and seasonal messaging (viewed 2026-10-15; page shows no year); Edible Berkshires' Summer 2026 guide (published 2026-06-23) lists it.

eats.name: Sleder's Family Tavern
eats.what_to_order: Hand-pattied beef burgers, the Bean Soup, or the all-you-can-eat fish on Fridays.
eats.why: Founded in 1882 and billed by its own site as Michigan's oldest continuously operated restaurant, in the original building with its tin-stamped ceiling.
eats.hours_note: Mon-Sat 11am-9pm, Sun noon-9pm; closed Easter, Thanksgiving and Christmas.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer, current hours and a 2025 holiday-closure post (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Folgarelli's Market & Wine Shop
eats.what_to_order: A deli sandwich such as the Italian Club, Antipasto Supreme or Doc's Special.
eats.why: A family-run Italian deli that has traded on West Front Street since 1978, handy for picnic sandwiches before the M-22 drive.
eats.hours_note: Tuesday-Saturday 9:30am-5:30pm; closed Sunday and Monday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and its online-ordering data shows updates as recent as 2026-09-03; the page itself shows no copyright year (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Cherry Public House
eats.what_to_order: Cherry pie with ice cream, or a flight from the twelve taps of ales, lagers and ciders.
eats.why: Run by Cherry Republic on its Glen Arbor campus, so the cherry pie is the local-fruit stop of a Sleeping Bear day.
eats.hours_note: Daily 11am-8pm, year-round per the venue; call (231) 226-3033 to order a pie 24 hours ahead.
eats.open_evidence: Own page shows a 2026 copyright footer and current daily hours and an October-April Quiz Night schedule (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Darrow's Family Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: Breakfast is served 8-11am daily, with lunch and dinner entrees after 11am.
eats.why: A single-location family restaurant open for all three meals before or after the Mackinac Bridge and ferry.
eats.hours_note: Closes for the 2026 season on Sunday, October 18. Hours 8am-8pm Sun-Thu and 8am-8:30pm Fri-Sat; no takeout orders after 5pm Mon-Sat or all day Sunday and holidays.
eats.open_evidence: Own website states the restaurant will close for the 2026 season on Sunday, October 18 and lists current hours (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Audie's Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: Casual meals in the Family Room (opens 8am) or dinner in the Chippewa Room (opens 5pm).
eats.why: Says it has served Mackinaw City since the Mackinac Bridge was built, and unlike many town restaurants stays open all year.
eats.hours_note: Open 7 days a week, year round per the venue; Family Room from 8am, Chippewa Room from 5pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and a copyright of 2003-26 (viewed 2026-10-15).

stops.note: Per the Mackinac Island Tourism Bureau's 2026 season list, most island restaurants close between October 17 and October 25, and only Doud's Market and the Mustang Lounge stay open year-round. Our advice: if you visit in the last week of October, check each place's closing date first.

eats.name: Seabiscuit Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Breakfast, lunch or dinner on Main Street; the site highlights its Seabiscuit Sangria.
eats.why: A Main Street cafe serving all three meals, with online takeout ordering, for a day of cycling the island.
eats.hours_note: Open 8am to midnight, April 25-October 24, 2026 per its own site; the Tourism Bureau's season list shows a last day of October 25.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright and 'April 25-October 24, 2026' hours; the Tourism Bureau 2026 closing list also includes it (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Doud's Market
eats.what_to_order: Deli and pizza menus are offered; the site does not name individual items.
eats.why: A family-owned island grocery since 1884, a practical place to pick up a picnic lunch for the perimeter-road ride.
eats.hours_note: Main Street store Monday-Saturday 7:30am-11pm; ferry-dock satellite Sun-Thu 7:30am-6pm, Fri-Sat 7:30am-8pm. The Tourism Bureau's 2026 list shows Doud's Market & Deli closing October 18 and the market itself open year-round.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright and current hours, and the Mackinac Island Tourism Bureau's 2026 season list names it (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Traffic Jam & Snug
eats.what_to_order: House-brewed beers such as the Grand Theft Pilsner or Java Porter, plus bakery pies, cakes and ice cream with hot fudge.
eats.why: A single-location Midtown restaurant at 511 W Canfield that makes its own bread, beer, cheese and ice cream on site, near the Cultural Center museums.
eats.hours_note: Listed hours: Wednesday-Saturday 11am-8pm, Sunday 11am-7pm; no Monday or Tuesday hours are listed.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer and current hours (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Eastern Market Saturday Market
eats.what_to_order: Fresh produce and local goods from the market sheds; the page names no individual vendors.
eats.why: The market calls itself one of the oldest continuously running markets in America and holds its main Saturday market in the Eastern Market district.
eats.hours_note: Saturday Market 6am-4pm at 2934 Russell St; next listed dates include Saturday October 17, 2026.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists 2026 events including the October 17 Saturday Market and current hours (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Uncle Loui's Café
eats.what_to_order: Stuffed French Toast, the Green Eggs & Ham Omelet or Eggs Benedict, all named on the cafe's own site.
eats.why: A single-location Duluth breakfast spot open since November 1993, serving homemade pancakes, omelets and scramblers before a drive up the shore.
eats.hours_note: Tuesday-Friday 6:00 AM-1:00 PM; Saturday-Sunday 7:00 AM-1:00 PM (Monday not listed as open), per the cafe's own site.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer, current hours and menu (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Duluth Grill
eats.what_to_order: The brunch salad with goat cheese and cilantro lime vinaigrette, or chicken and waffles, both featured on its homepage.
eats.why: Family-owned original of a small Duluth restaurant group, serving breakfast and brunch with an emphasis on local and organic ingredients; the Duluthian magazine described it as the group's pioneering restaurant.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 8 AM-3 PM per its own site and Visit Duluth; the homepage carries no year.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows daily 8 AM-3 PM hours and a live open/closed status (page has no year, viewed 2026-10-15); Duluthian magazine article dated 2026-02-26 describes it as still operating under the Hanson family.

eats.name: Rustic Inn Café
eats.what_to_order: Fresh Lake Superior fish in season (lake trout, bluefin) or its pies, including caramel apple pecan and chocolate, both named on its site.
eats.why: On Highway 61 on the North Shore route, a single-location cafe serving breakfast, lunch and dinner; its site says it is open year round.
eats.hours_note: Its site lists summer hours of Monday-Saturday 8 AM-7 PM and Sunday 8 AM-5 PM and says it is open year round; confirm off-season hours by phone (218-834-2488).
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer, 'open year round' and current menu content (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Brainstorm Bakery
eats.what_to_order: The Original Cranberry Apple Crapola granola, the bakery's own product featured on its site.
eats.why: Home base of Ely's Crapola granola, handy for stocking up before a Boundary Waters trip.
eats.hours_note: Monday-Saturday 7 AM-4 PM per its own site.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer and lists current storefront hours at 402 E Sheridan St (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Frisky Otter Pub & Eatery
eats.what_to_order: The Walleye Basket or the Frisky Otter Famous Smash Burger, both listed on its menu page.
eats.why: Pub-style eatery on Ely's Sheridan Street with a menu that includes walleye and Italian beef sandwiches.
eats.hours_note: 2026 fall/winter hours: Sunday 11 AM-8 PM; Monday 11 AM-9 PM; Tuesday-Wednesday closed; Thursday 3-9 PM; Friday-Saturday 11 AM-9 PM. Its breakfast page says breakfast resumes 'in the spring 2027', so do not count on breakfast now.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer and posted 2026 fall/winter hours (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Hell's Kitchen
eats.what_to_order: The dinner page names baby back ribs, pan-fried walleye, barbacoa short rib and double smashed burgers, and the menu includes all-day breakfast.
eats.why: Single-location, 100% employee-owned restaurant in an underground space at 80 S. 9th St. downtown, handy for the riverfront and Walker Art Center day.
eats.hours_note: Sunday-Thursday 7:30 AM-8:30 PM; Friday-Saturday 7:30 AM-10 PM; last food orders 30 minutes before closing; dinner service begins at 3 PM.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, a dinner menu and employee-ownership since 2020, and its text refers to 2026 (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Kramarczuk's
eats.what_to_order: Sausages, cabbage rolls and baked goods, the Eastern European foods its homepage highlights.
eats.why: Single-location Eastern European deli and sausage shop at 215 E. Hennepin Ave., a short walk from St. Anthony Falls and the Stone Arch Bridge.
eats.hours_note: Tuesday-Saturday 10 AM-8 PM per its own site; credit card only, no cash or checks.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer, current hours and the card-only payment notice (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Cossetta Alimentari
eats.what_to_order: Pizza, pasta, cannoli pastries and gelato, which its homepage features.
eats.why: St. Paul's Little Italy institution at 211 W. 7th St. combining a 300-seat eatery and pizzeria, an Italian market and a pasticceria in one building.
eats.hours_note: Eatery & Pizzeria 11 AM-9 PM daily; Italian Market 10 AM-8 PM daily; closed New Year's, Easter, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2025 copyright footer, a current Hours & Location page and a promotion for limited-batch panettone orders (viewed 2026-10-15); footer is 2025 rather than 2026.

eats.name: Walnut Hills
eats.what_to_order: Fried chicken and the Pecan Praline Pie, both named on the restaurant's own site.
eats.why: A long-running Vicksburg Southern restaurant that Visit Vicksburg calls an icon, serving plantation-style cooking in an 1880s home.
eats.hours_note: Monday-Saturday 11am-9pm, Sunday 11am-2pm; closed Tuesdays (Visit Vicksburg listing).
eats.open_evidence: Own site walnuthillsms.com lists current hours and dishes but shows no copyright year (viewed 2026-10-15); Visit Vicksburg listing (2026 footer) shows the same hours and says Tuesday closed (viewed 2026-10-15).
eats.source_name: Visit Vicksburg (Vicksburg Convention and Visitors Bureau) and walnuthillsms.com

eats.name: Main Street Market Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Betty's Biscuits, gumbo, muffulettas, quiches and homemade pies, per the cafe's site; the menu changes weekly.
eats.why: A Cajun- and Creole-leaning downtown lunch cafe at 902 Cherry Street with a menu that changes with what is local and seasonal.
eats.hours_note: Lunch Monday-Friday 11am-2pm; closed Saturday and Sunday. Visit Vicksburg also lists Monday nights by reservation.
eats.open_evidence: Own site mainstreetmarketcafe.com shows a 2025 copyright and current weekly menu (viewed 2026-10-15); Visit Vicksburg listing with 2026 footer shows the same hours (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: The Tomato Place
eats.what_to_order: The BLT made with fresh tomatoes, po'boys and sandwiches, per the Visit Vicksburg listing.
eats.why: On Highway 61 South, a produce stand with a Caribbean- and New Orleans-themed kitchen and open-air seating.
eats.hours_note: Open daily: market 7am-6pm, kitchen 8am-6pm (Visit Vicksburg).
eats.open_evidence: Visit Vicksburg listing with 2026 footer shows current daily hours and menu (viewed 2026-10-15); the venue's own website did not load, so the tourism listing is the only evidence.
eats.source_name: Visit Vicksburg (Vicksburg Convention and Visitors Bureau)

eats.name: Fat Mama's Tamales
eats.what_to_order: Tamales, chili and margaritas, plus nachos, gringo pie, boudin and the Fire and Ice pickles, per the restaurant's site and Visit Natchez.
eats.why: A Natchez tamale restaurant at 303 S. Canal Street with a drive-thru, an air-conditioned dining room and a shaded deck.
eats.hours_note: Monday-Thursday 11am-9pm, Friday-Saturday 11am-10pm, Sunday noon-7pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own site fatmamastamales.com lists current hours but its footer shows no year (viewed 2026-10-15); Visit Natchez listing with 2026 footer shows the same hours (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Natchez Coffee Company
eats.what_to_order: Coffee, espresso and cappuccinos with breakfast and lunch sandwiches and salads; Blue Bell ice cream is also listed.
eats.why: A downtown coffee shop at 509 Franklin Street, within walking distance of the downtown hotels and B&Bs, serving full breakfast and lunch.
eats.hours_note: Monday-Saturday 6am-5pm, Sunday 6am-2pm.
eats.open_evidence: Visit Natchez listing with 2026 footer shows current hours and menu (viewed 2026-10-15); no own website was fetched.

eats.name: Port City Café
eats.what_to_order: Po-boys, red beans and rice with sausage and shrimp spaghetti, per the Coastal Mississippi listing.
eats.why: On Pass Road in Biloxi rather than the beachfront, a Southern Gulf-to-table cafe serving breakfast, brunch and home-cooked specialties.
eats.hours_note: Sunday-Wednesday 7am-3pm, Thursday-Saturday 7am-9pm.
eats.open_evidence: Coastal Mississippi directory listing with 2026 footer shows current hours and menu (viewed 2026-10-15); the venue's own site was not fetched.

eats.name: Blue Dog Bistro
eats.what_to_order: Breakfast and lunch plus drinks from the full-service barista bar; the menu accommodates vegan, keto, paleo and gluten-free diets, per Visit Mississippi.
eats.why: On Government Street, billed by Visit Mississippi as the first vegan, keto, paleo and gluten-free friendly restaurant on the Mississippi Gulf Coast.
eats.hours_note: Tuesday-Sunday 7am-3pm; closed Monday.
eats.open_evidence: Visit Mississippi listing with 2026 footer shows current hours (viewed 2026-10-15); the venue's own site returned a 404, so the tourism listing is the only evidence.

eats.name: Butcher Baker
eats.what_to_order: Wagyu pastrami sandwich and bacon pizza are named on the site; the menu is printed daily.
eats.why: A restaurant on Thorn Street that opened in 2024, with a daily-changing menu and weekend brunch.
eats.hours_note: Tuesday 10am-2pm, Wednesday-Friday 11am-9pm, Saturday 10am-9pm with brunch from 10am, Sunday brunch 10am-2pm; closed Monday.
eats.open_evidence: Own site butcherbakeros.com shows a 2025 copyright, current hours and reservation links (viewed 2026-10-15); the footer is one year old, and it is a recent opening rather than a long-running institution.

eats.name: Maringouin
eats.what_to_order: The site names no dishes; it describes a menu that blends international cultures with local influences.
eats.why: A dinner restaurant at 604 Porter Avenue with a modern menu mixing international cooking and local ingredients.
eats.hours_note: Kitchen Tuesday-Saturday 5-10pm; Tuesday-Friday happy hour 3-5pm; Sunday and Monday 3-9pm bar only.
eats.open_evidence: Own site themaringouin.com shows a 2026 copyright and current hours (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Mockingbird Café
eats.what_to_order: Buttermilk biscuits, pancakes, muffins, jams and omelets with locally roasted coffee, per the Coastal Mississippi listing.
eats.why: An Old Town cafe at 110 S. Second Street that its own site says has operated since 2006, after Hurricane Katrina.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 7am-2pm; no reservations; plastic-free to-go items.
eats.open_evidence: Own site mockingbirdcafe.com lists current daily hours but shows no copyright year (viewed 2026-10-15); Coastal Mississippi listing with 2026 footer shows the same hours (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Stewart's Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: Homemade biscuits and gravy, the pork tenderloin sandwich, the Diet Plate, or the oversized cinnamon roll (shareable, per the article).
eats.why: A no-frills lake-area breakfast institution that has been in business since 1953; the Camdenton location is at 98 E. U.S. 54, a short drive from Ha Ha Tonka.
eats.hours_note: Breakfast and lunch only. Its own website lists 7am-2pm, 7 days a week (that page carries no year); a Lake of the Ozarks visitor-bureau listing says 6am, so confirm the opening time.
eats.open_evidence: Springfield Daily Citizen Camdenton dining guide dated 2026-02-24 (updated 2026-04-13) lists the Camdenton location at 98 E. U.S. 54 as open for breakfast and lunch; its own site stewartsrestaurants.com lists three locations plus a fourth coming (viewed 2026-10-15; that page shows no year).

stops.note: The NPS dining page for Ozark National Scenic Riverways (last updated December 2017) says there were no restaurants within the park, that the surrounding communities offer everything from formal dining rooms to country diners, and that canoe rentals often have small stores selling convenience foods. Our advice: eat in Eminence town or at Echo Bluff State Park, and pack lunch and snacks for float day.

eats.name: Creekside Grill at Echo Bluff State Park
eats.what_to_order: Classic American dishes from the breakfast or all-day menu; the page says meat is sourced from sustainable, humane systems.
eats.why: Inside the Echo Bluff Lodge in Echo Bluff State Park, outside Eminence town itself (the day-4 stop on this route), with indoor and outdoor seating overlooking Echo Bluff.
eats.hours_note: Own page lists breakfast 7:30-10am daily and lunch/dinner 11am-8pm Sunday-Thursday, 11am-9pm Friday-Saturday. A search snippet from the same site showed shorter winter hours from November 4 (year not shown), so confirm hours before driving.
eats.open_evidence: Echo Bluff State Park's own Creekside Grill page says 'Open daily', lists hours and menus, and has a 2026 footer (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Billy Gail's
eats.what_to_order: The 14-inch sweet cream vanilla pancakes, biscuits, or country fried steak; breakfast is served all day.
eats.why: A local three-restaurant group (two in Branson, one in nearby Ozark) known for oversized pancakes and Ozarks comfort food.
eats.hours_note: Own page lists Sunday-Thursday 7am-3pm and Friday-Saturday 7am-9pm; hours may differ by location.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2025 copyright footer, current hours and menu, and was last modified 2026-07-15 per the page metadata (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Jackie B. Goode's Uptown Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Country fried steak, fish and chips, a Reuben, or starters such as fried pickles and fried green beans.
eats.why: Right on the 76 Strip and serving Branson since 1993, under the same ownership since 2008.
eats.hours_note: Own site lists Monday-Thursday 8am-8pm, Friday-Saturday 8am-11pm, closed Sundays.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu, shows a 2026 footer, and its page metadata gives a publication date of 2026-09-09 (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Anthonino's Taverna
eats.what_to_order: Toasted ravioli, its signature dish per the site, or spaghetti from the Italian and Greek scratch-made menu.
eats.why: A single-location family restaurant at 2225 Macklind Ave in The Hill, the Italian neighborhood where toasted ravioli is a local specialty; the Explore St. Louis guide to The Hill also lists it.
eats.hours_note: Own site lists Monday-Saturday 11am-10pm, closed Sundays.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, an online reserve-a-table option and a 2026 footer (viewed 2026-10-15); Explore St. Louis's Hill guide lists it with the same address.

eats.name: Blueberry Hill Restaurant & Music Club
eats.what_to_order: Burgers and sandwiches, or toasted ravioli, cheeseballs and wings from the appetizer list.
eats.why: A single-location restaurant and live-music club open since 1972 at 6504 Delmar, in the Delmar Loop that the day-3 plan covers.
eats.hours_note: Food service 11am-9pm daily, with late-night orders at the bar; 21+ after 9pm except for all-ages shows.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer and lists upcoming events through October 2026 (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Ted Drewes Frozen Custard
eats.what_to_order: A concrete, the custard thick enough to turn upside down, with mix-ins from its 30-plus toppings.
eats.why: A family business since 1929, now in its fourth generation, on historic Route 66 at 6726 Chippewa.
eats.hours_note: Chippewa location lists Monday-Sunday 11am-10:30pm. The South Grand location is summer-only and the page shows it 'closed for the season'.
eats.open_evidence: Own website carries a 2026 copyright footer and a current seasonal status for each location (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Shakespeare's Pizza
eats.what_to_order: The Masterpiece or Panda's Pepper pizza, or pizza by the slice.
eats.why: A Columbia tradition since 1973 with three Columbia locations; the downtown one is at 225 S. Ninth Street, about the halfway point on the I-70 drive.
eats.open_evidence: Own website carries a 2026 copyright footer and lists three Columbia locations with phone numbers and online ordering (viewed 2026-10-15); no hours were shown.

eats.name: Stroud's Oak Ridge Manor
eats.what_to_order: The fried chicken, which the site presents as its specialty.
eats.why: Fried chicken in an expanded 1829 log cabin and farmhouse in North Kansas City, north of downtown rather than in the Crossroads or Plaza.
eats.hours_note: Own site lists Monday-Thursday 4-9pm, Friday 11am-9pm, Saturday 2-9pm, Sunday 11am-9pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, online ordering and a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Char Bar
eats.what_to_order: Pit-smoked meats; the site also mentions cheesy hushpuppies on the happy-hour menu.
eats.why: The Kansas City location is in historic Westport, with a large beer garden and yard games; Char Bar has three locations in total (Kansas City, Parkville, Olathe).
eats.open_evidence: Own website carries a 2026 footer and a 2026 Oktoberfest promotion with images uploaded in 2026-10, plus a happy hour Monday-Friday 3-6pm (viewed 2026-10-15); no opening hours were shown.

eats.name: The Campground
eats.what_to_order: Burgers (with burger specials every Monday), craft cocktails and its s'mores, per the site.
eats.why: A single-location restaurant at 1531 Genessee St in the West Bottoms, the district the day-6 plan visits.
eats.open_evidence: Own website carries a 2026 footer, a reservation system and carryout ordering, and a banner advertising 'Burger Specials Every Monday' (viewed 2026-10-15); the banner's block-party date shows no year and no hours were shown, so this is moderate evidence.

stops.note: Per the NPS Operating Hours & Seasons page (last updated September 13, 2022, so confirm current status), the camp store in Apgar Village 'may still be open and provides snacks and drinks' once the park's seasonal services wind down. Our advice: eat in Columbia Falls or Hungry Horse before heading into the park and pack lunch and snacks for park days.

eats.name: Outlaw Diner
eats.what_to_order: The menu lists scrambles, biscuits n gravy, waffles and local Angus burgers.
eats.why: An all-day breakfast and lunch counter on Nucleus Avenue in Columbia Falls, a one-location diner that serves seven days a week.
eats.hours_note: Open 7 am to 3 pm, seven days a week. Counter service only, and the site says it does not prepare eggs to order.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows 7 am-3 pm daily hours and a current menu with a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: The Huckleberry Patch
eats.what_to_order: Per Glacier Country's listing, Erna's 'World Famous Homemade Huckleberry Pies'; the business also runs a bakery and restaurant.
eats.why: In the neighbouring town of Hungry Horse rather than Columbia Falls itself: Montana's original huckleberry cannery, on US Highway 2 on the way to the park's west entrance.
eats.hours_note: Open year-round with seasonal hours. Own site: summer 9 am-9 pm, winter 11 am-6 pm; Glacier Country listing: fall 9 am-8 pm, winter 10 am-6 pm. The two pages disagree on the winter opening time and the own site does not say when the winter schedule starts, so check before driving out late in the day. Own site notes closures and reduced hours around Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year's Day.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists summer and winter hours and holiday hours with a 2026 footer, and the Glacier Country tourism listing states it is open year-round (both viewed 2026-10-14).
eats.source_name: Glacier Country tourism listing (own site: huckleberrypatch.com)

eats.name: Three Forks Grille
eats.what_to_order: The page shows a dinner menu of appetizers, entrees and desserts but the text we could read named no individual dishes.
eats.why: A dinner restaurant on Nucleus Avenue in Columbia Falls that says on its site it has been operating since 2010.
eats.hours_note: Site says open 7 days a week from 5 pm, seating until 9 pm, first-come first-served.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and a dinner menu (viewed 2026-10-14), but the page shows no year or copyright date, so this is weaker evidence than the other eats; call 406-892-2900 to confirm.

eats.name: Paul's Pancake Parlor
eats.what_to_order: Pancakes: the menu lists buttermilk, caramel pecan nut, buckwheat, sourdough and blueberry sourdough varieties, and it highlights a sourdough starter described as 'well over 100 years old'.
eats.why: An old-school Missoula breakfast diner on Brooks Street that says it has been serving since 1963.
eats.hours_note: Open every day 6 am-4 pm.
eats.open_evidence: Destination Missoula's breakfast guide, updated 11/7/25, lists it at 2305 Brooks Street with daily 6 am-4 pm hours, and its own site shows the same hours and current menu (viewed 2026-10-14; the own site's footer year is not reliable, so the dated tourism page is the main evidence).

eats.name: Ruby's Cafe
eats.what_to_order: The tourism page describes an old-school diner with a classic breakfast menu and names no individual dishes.
eats.why: A diner on Regent Street in Missoula that stays open through mid-afternoon, useful for a late breakfast or early lunch.
eats.hours_note: Monday-Saturday 6 am-4 pm; Sunday 8 am-3 pm.
eats.open_evidence: Destination Missoula's breakfast guide, updated 11/7/25, lists it at 2101 Regent Street with current hours (viewed 2026-10-14); we did not reach its own website.

eats.name: Cafe Mimosa
eats.what_to_order: Chicken and waffles, acai bowls and avocado toast, per the tourism page.
eats.why: A breakfast and lunch cafe at 101 S Higgins Ave in Missoula.
eats.hours_note: Open every day 8 am-3 pm.
eats.open_evidence: Destination Missoula's breakfast guide, updated 11/7/25, lists it with daily 8 am-3 pm hours (viewed 2026-10-14); we did not reach its own website.

eats.name: Red Rooster Artisan Bakery
eats.what_to_order: Cranberry walnut bread, lemon bars, carrot cake and a BLT with avocado are named on the site.
eats.why: A bakery and cafe on South First Street in Hamilton that bakes hand-shaped artisan loaves in a brick oven, a good breakfast or lunch stop on the Bitterroot Valley day.
eats.hours_note: Monday-Saturday 7 am-3 pm (breakfast 7-11 am, lunch 11 am-3 pm); closed Sunday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, menu and online ordering with a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: 2nd Street Sushi and Asian Grill
eats.what_to_order: The homepage names no individual dishes; it describes Asian cuisine with dine-in and takeout.
eats.why: A Hamilton restaurant that says on its own site it has been serving Asian cuisine since August 2008, and one of the few Hamilton places we could verify for dinner.
eats.hours_note: Tuesday-Saturday 11 am-9 pm; closed Sunday and Monday, Thanksgiving and Christmas.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and holiday closures with a 'Copyright 2025' footer (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Flyover Brewing Company
eats.what_to_order: Salads, handhelds and the weekly lunch specials, per a 2026 local-news feature.
eats.why: In downtown Scottsbluff (the Gering and Scottsbluff area is the Panhandle's main dining cluster); its own site bills it as the first brewery in the Nebraska Panhandle, in a renovated downtown building.
eats.hours_note: Tuesday-Sunday 11am-11pm, closed Monday (per its own site; the page shows no year).
eats.open_evidence: KNOP/KNOPNews2 (1011now) feature dated 2026-04-23 describes the downtown Scottsbluff brewery's expansion and added lunch menu; own site lists hours and 1824 Broadway (viewed 2026-10-16, page shows only a 2017 copyright).

eats.name: Johnny's Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Hand-cut aged steaks and prime rib, per the 2025-2026 features; the 2025 feature also names liver and onions.
eats.why: In South Omaha next to the former stockyards, a family-run steakhouse opened in 1922 and now run by the third generation.
eats.hours_note: Closed Sundays; lunch Tuesday-Friday 11am-2pm; dinner Tuesday-Thursday until 8pm and Friday-Saturday until 9pm (per its own site).
eats.open_evidence: Flatwater Free Press article dated 2026-02-26 reports it as a 2026 James Beard America's Classics winner still operating; own site lists current hours and the same award (viewed 2026-10-16); 1011now feature dated 2025-02-28.
eats.source_name: Flatwater Free Press (2026-02-26); own site johnnyscafe.com

eats.name: Block 16
eats.what_to_order: Burgers such as the Block Burger and French Onion Smash, or the poutine, from its menu.
eats.why: A single-location street-food counter at 1611 Farnam St in downtown Omaha, with a locally sourced, partly vegan menu.
eats.hours_note: Monday-Wednesday 11am-2pm; Thursday-Saturday 11am-8pm; closed Sunday (per its own site).
eats.open_evidence: Own site shows a 2026 copyright, current hours and menu (viewed 2026-10-16).

eats.name: Upstream Brewing Company
eats.what_to_order: Its Smoked Gouda & Beer soup or the Pub Burger, both listed on its own food menu.
eats.why: Omaha's original brewpub, open since 1996, at 514 S 11th St in the Old Market.
eats.hours_note: Monday-Thursday 11am-10pm, Friday-Saturday 11am-11pm, Sunday 10am-10pm (per its own site).
eats.open_evidence: Own site shows a 2026 copyright, current hours and a current food menu (viewed 2026-10-16).

eats.name: The Rabbit Hole Bakery
eats.what_to_order: Cakes, brownies, cookies and tarts, made fresh daily per its own site.
eats.why: A Haymarket dessert bakery at 8th and Q streets, with one other location at Gateway Mall.
eats.hours_note: Haymarket: Monday-Friday 10am-8pm, Saturday 8am-8pm, Sunday 11am-8pm (per its own site).
eats.open_evidence: Own site shows a 2026 copyright and current hours (viewed 2026-10-16); also listed in the downtown Haymarket directory.

eats.name: Ivanna Cone
eats.what_to_order: Its four staple flavors: Dutch Chocolate, Sweet Cream Vanilla, Fresh Strawberry and Cinnamon.
eats.why: A single-location ice cream shop at 701 P St in the Haymarket; in-shop purchases only.
eats.hours_note: Monday-Thursday 12-9:30pm, Friday-Saturday 12-10:30pm, Sunday 1-9pm (per its own site).
eats.open_evidence: Own site shows a 2026 copyright and current hours (viewed 2026-10-16).

eats.name: Bob Taylor's Original Ranch House
eats.what_to_order: The site lists the half-pound 'Duke' Burger at lunch, Smoked Prime Rib & Lobster Tail at dinner, and Key Lime Pie for dessert.
eats.why: In northwest Las Vegas, well away from the casino corridor, a single-location mesquite-grilled steakhouse that has operated since 1955 and won a 2026 James Beard America's Classics award.
eats.hours_note: Per its website: Monday-Thursday and Sunday 11:00 AM-10:00 PM, Friday-Saturday 11:00 AM-11:00 PM. Site calls itself a 'premiere steak house & fine dining'; call ahead for a table (702-645-1399).
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows current hours, menu and a 2026 James Beard Award notice (viewed 2026-10-15); jamesbeard.org's 2026 America's Classics winners page lists it as the only Nevada winner (viewed 2026-10-15).

stops.note: Boulder City is the nearest town of independent restaurants to Hoover Dam; the city's dining directory lists 45+ places, many of them national chains, so the entries here are chosen as locally owned. Our advice: eat here before or after the dam rather than at the dam itself.

eats.name: Boulder Dam Brewing Company
eats.what_to_order: The menu lists a Hatch Chile Burger, Beer Battered Fish 'n Chips, Philly Cheesesteak and Brewpub Nachos, alongside 18 rotating beers and ciders.
eats.why: Boulder City's own brewpub on Nevada Way, a single-location operation open since the 2013 copyright date on its site and a few minutes' drive from Hoover Dam.
eats.hours_note: Per its website: Sunday-Thursday 11:00 AM-9:00 PM, Friday-Saturday 11:00 AM-11:00 PM.
eats.open_evidence: Own website footer reads 2013-2026, lists current hours, a priced menu with items flagged 'NEW', and September 2026 live-music listings (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Savage Grill
eats.what_to_order: Burgers, steak sandwiches, French dips and fries per the Storey County Chamber listing; the Comstock Chronicle also mentions chili and specialty sausages.
eats.why: A family-owned lunch spot at 65 N C Street in a historic building whose basement holds authenticated early-1900s signatures and graffiti, run by local residents David and Sheila.
eats.hours_note: Chamber listing: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday 11:30 AM-4 PM, Friday-Saturday 11 AM-8 PM, Sunday 11 AM-4 PM, closed Wednesday (the Chamber's hours are undated, and an August 2025 Comstock Chronicle article gave different hours, Thursday-Monday 11 AM-5 PM), so call ahead (775-223-9665).
eats.open_evidence: Comstock Chronicle (20 January 2026) lists it among Virginia City ventures launched in Summer 2025, and the Storey County Chamber of Commerce page shows current hours and 2025 founding (viewed 2026-10-15); no first-party site found and the newest dated source is nine months old.
eats.source_name: Storey County Chamber of Commerce; Comstock Chronicle

eats.name: Polly's Pancake Parlor
eats.what_to_order: Made-from-scratch pancakes (oatmeal buttermilk, buckwheat or whole wheat) and waffles with New Hampshire maple syrup.
eats.why: In the neighbouring town of Sugar Hill rather than Franconia itself; run by the same family since 1938 and a short drive from Franconia Notch.
eats.hours_note: Per its hours page: fall hours Thursday-Tuesday 7am-2pm (Saturday-Sunday to 3pm), closed Wednesday; from October 22 winter hours are Thursday-Monday 7am-2pm, closed Tuesday and Wednesday. First-come, first-served, no reservations; the first 20 days of October are the busiest and waits can run past closing.
eats.open_evidence: Own website footer reads 2026 and its hours page gives fall hours and a winter schedule starting October 22 (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Iron Furnace Brewing
eats.what_to_order: Its own craft beer, with food service and cans to go; the site also offers online ordering.
eats.why: A one-location brewpub on Franconia's Main Street, useful for an evening meal after a day on the Notch trails.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: Monday and Thursday 3-8pm, Friday 3-9pm, Saturday 12-9pm, Sunday 12-6pm; closed Tuesday and Wednesday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website footer reads 2026 and lists current weekly hours and online ordering (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Inkwell Coffee House
eats.what_to_order: Espresso drinks and nitro cold brew, with breakfast sandwiches and house-made baked goods.
eats.why: A downtown Exeter coffee shop in the historic IOKA Theater building on Water Street; a small local pair of shops (Exeter and Littleton).
eats.hours_note: Per its Exeter page: Monday-Friday 7am-3pm, Saturday 8am-3pm, closed Sunday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website footer reads Copyright 2025 and its Exeter page lists current hours and online ordering (viewed 2026-10-15); the footer shows no 2026 year.

eats.name: GINGER FOX Artisan Bakery
eats.what_to_order: European-inspired pastries, with a fall menu listing apple cruffins, pumpkin lattes and cranberry almond scones.
eats.why: In the neighbouring town of Stratham (100 Portsmouth Ave) rather than Exeter itself, on the way in from the coast.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: Tuesday-Friday 7am-3pm, Saturday-Sunday 7:30am-2pm, closed Monday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website footer reads Copyright 2026 and shows a current fall menu and weekly hours (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Kaffee Vonsolln
eats.what_to_order: Its own small-batch roasted coffee (the Kick Blend dark roast, cold brew, espresso drinks) with pastries, cookies, sandwiches and soup.
eats.why: A family-owned single-location cafe and coffee roastery on Daniel Street since 2010, a few minutes' walk from Market Square.
eats.open_evidence: Own website footer reads 2026 and shows current products and online ordering; hours are on a contact page that was not retrieved (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: The Galley Hatch Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: Traditional American food highlighting fresh New England seafood and seasonal flavors, lunch and dinner daily; Kay's Cafe in the same building does a fast-casual breakfast menu until noon.
eats.why: On Lafayette Road in Hampton rather than on the beach strip; family owned and operated since 1970.
eats.hours_note: Site lists 'Fall Hours': Sunday-Thursday 11:30am-8:30pm, Friday-Saturday 11:30am-9pm (the page does not say when fall hours end). Kay's Cafe breakfast daily until noon.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists fall hours and a Thanksgiving pre-order page with 2026 dates (order by 11/18/2026, pickup 11/24-11/25/2026); the site footer reads 2024 (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: White Oak Market
eats.what_to_order: The site highlights breakfast sandwiches, subs, wraps and paninis, plus daily specials.
eats.why: A family-owned shop on Central Avenue in Seaside Park itself, handy for an early start before Island Beach State Park.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: Mon, Wed, Thu 7am-4pm; Fri-Sun 7am-5pm; closed Tuesday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows current hours, a 'newly renovated shop' notice and a 2026 copyright (viewed 2026-10-15)

eats.name: Ebby's Ristorante and Lounge
eats.what_to_order: The site describes a modern Italian family restaurant and mentions homemade bottled sauces; it names no specific dishes on the homepage.
eats.why: Single-location Italian dinner spot on Central Avenue in Seaside Park; its site says it has more than 30 years at the Jersey Shore.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: open 7 days a week, 4pm-11pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows 'Now Open 7 Days a Week' hours, current promotions and a 2026 copyright (viewed 2026-10-15)

eats.name: Pop's Corner
eats.what_to_order: The site names cookies and coffee, including an October 'Salted Pumpkin Spice Latte' cookie of the month, and chocolate chip cookies.

eats.name: Szalay's Farm & Market
eats.what_to_order: Locally made and baked goods, plus pumpkins and mums in the fall; the site has an outdoor eateries section.
eats.why: Just outside the village, on Riverview Road with a Peninsula address; a single-location family farm market with a fall maze and hayride, per the Summit County Farm Bureau listing.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 9am-7pm. A Summit County Farm Bureau listing dated 2026-06-01 gives the season as June 1 to October 31, so it closes for the year in about two weeks; the farm's own site does not state season dates.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists daily hours with a 2026 copyright footer, and the Summit County Farm Bureau's 2026 farm-markets feature (published 2026-06-01) lists the June 1-October 31 season (both viewed 2026-10-15).
eats.source_name: Venue's own website; Summit County Farm Bureau

eats.name: Great Lakes Brewing Company Brewpub
eats.what_to_order: Great Lakes Fish & Chips made with local walleye; Sunday brunch is also served.
eats.why: The brewery's single brewpub sits on Market Avenue in Ohio City, across from the West Side Market.
eats.hours_note: Mon-Thu 11:30am-9pm, Fri-Sat 11:30am-10pm, Sun 11am-3pm (per own site, viewed 2026-10-15).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu with a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Arnold's Old Fashioned Hamburgers
eats.what_to_order: The Tulsa Flyer guide lists cheeseburgers, cherry limeade and malts; NewsOn6 says the patties are ground in-house daily and the menu is unchanged.
eats.why: A Tulsa burger counter off Route 66 in the Crystal City Shopping Center, open since 1986 and owned by Frank Arnold.
eats.open_evidence: Tulsa Flyer's 24 March 2026 Route 66 dining guide lists it at 4253 Southwest Blvd as operating since 1986 and celebrating 40 years (viewed 2026-10-15); NewsOn6 feature on the owner's upcoming 40th anniversary also fetched. No venue-owned page was found, and no hours were stated on either page.

eats.name: El Rancho Grande
eats.what_to_order: The site names cheese enchiladas and frozen margaritas, with tacos, burritos and fajitas also on the menu.
eats.why: Tulsa's oldest Mexican restaurant per its own site, on 11th Street (Route 66) since 1953 and open since 1950.
eats.hours_note: Open Monday-Saturday 11 a.m.-9 p.m.; closed Sundays (per own site).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists hours and a current menu and its text refers to a 2026 vote, so the page is current (viewed 2026-10-15); also listed in the Tulsa Flyer's 24 March 2026 Route 66 guide.

eats.name: Cattlemen's Steakhouse
eats.what_to_order: The site describes aged steaks and breakfasts, with breakfast, lunch and dinner all served.
eats.why: In Stockyards City, described in a February 2026 news article as Oklahoma City's longest continuously operating restaurant (founded 1910), serving breakfast, lunch and dinner.
eats.hours_note: Per own site: Sunday-Thursday 6 a.m.-10 p.m., Friday-Saturday 6 a.m.-11 p.m.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu with no copyright year (viewed 2026-10-15); a news article dated 2026-02-26 (viewed 2026-10-15) states it is open and operating under owner Brad Walters.

stops.note: El Reno is where the fried onion burger is said to have started; the festival page says fried onion burgers have been cooked daily in El Reno's diners and cafes since the early 1900s.

eats.name: Sid's Diner
eats.what_to_order: The site names onion burgers, cheeseburgers and breakfast plates.
eats.why: An El Reno diner at 300 S Choctaw Ave built around the town's fried onion burger.
eats.hours_note: Own site lists Monday-Saturday 7 a.m.-8:30 p.m. (breakfast menu 7-11 a.m.); Sunday hours are not stated on the page.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists hours and live online/app ordering but shows no year or copyright date (viewed 2026-10-15); no stronger dated source was found.

eats.name: Route 66 Cafe at the Market
eats.what_to_order: TravelOK names chicken fried steak, grilled onion burgers and meatloaf; the cafe's site lists French toast, catfish dinners and broasted chicken.
eats.why: A locally owned home-style kitchen at 301 W Gary Blvd on Route 66, in operation since 2009 and serving breakfast all day.
eats.hours_note: Per TravelOK: Sunday-Monday 9 a.m.-2 p.m., Wednesday-Thursday 7 a.m.-2 p.m., Friday 7 a.m.-8 p.m., Saturday 7 a.m.-2 p.m.; closed Tuesdays. The cafe's own contact page does not list hours.
eats.open_evidence: Own website footer reads "2026 by Route 66 Cafe at the Market" and offers online ordering (viewed 2026-10-15); hours come from the TravelOK listing, which shows no year.

eats.name: Takoda's Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: Pizza, burgers, sandwiches and house and dinner specialties are the menu sections on its site; Travel Oregon also mentions homemade soups and a salad bar.
eats.why: In the neighbouring community of Rainbow (Blue River mailing address, 91806 Mill Creek Road) on the McKenzie Highway, a short drive from McKenzie Bridge itself; family-friendly lunch-and-dinner stop on the McKenzie River route.
eats.hours_note: Own site shows "Open today 11:00 am - 08:00 pm"; Eagle Rock Lodge's dining page also lists it open daily 11 AM-8 PM.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a "Copyright 2026" footer, current menu sections and today's hours (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Double Mountain Brewery & Cidery
eats.what_to_order: New Haven-style pizzas such as the Shroom Hunter (white pie with pancetta and chanterelles), plus salads and sandwiches.
eats.why: Hood River brewery and taproom at 8 4th St; a small local group with two taprooms in Portland as well.
eats.hours_note: Hood River taproom: Sun-Thu 11:30 am-9:00 pm, Fri-Sat 11:30 am-10:00 pm (own site).
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer, current taproom hours and food menu (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: pFriem Family Brewers
eats.what_to_order: Beer: the homepage points to its 2026 package beer guide and names no food items.
eats.why: Waterfront tasting room at 707 Portway Ave in Hood River; the brewery has just one other tasting room, in Milwaukie.
eats.hours_note: Both tasting rooms normally open daily 11:30am-9:00pm (own homepage).
eats.open_evidence: Own homepage references its 2026 Package Beer Guide and carries a closure notice for "Tuesday, July 21st" (a Tuesday in 2026), viewed 2026-10-14.

eats.name: Multnomah Falls Lodge
eats.what_to_order: Breakfast, lunch/dinner and Sunday brunch menus are posted on its site; no individual dishes were named in text I could read.
eats.why: The lodge restaurant at the falls on the Historic Columbia River Highway, operating under a US Forest Service special use permit inside the Columbia River Gorge National Scenic Area.
eats.hours_note: Mon-Fri 9am-6pm, Sat-Sun 8am-6pm per own site; reservations encouraged but not required; the site says the elevator to the restaurant is available only intermittently during renovations.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer, current hours and a renovation notice (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Dan & Louis Oyster Bar
eats.what_to_order: Oysters (including baked), clam chowder, Oysters Rockefeller, seafood gumbo and prawn dishes.
eats.why: Downtown oyster bar at 208 SW Ankeny St, founded in 1907 and still run by the Wachsmuth family (five generations, per its site).
eats.hours_note: Site lists Fri-Sat 12:00 PM-10:00 PM and Sun, Mon, Thu 12:00 PM-9:00 PM; no Tuesday or Wednesday hours are listed, so confirm those days.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, says it has operated "over 119 years" (1907 to 2026) and carries a November 2024 community notice (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Cartopia
eats.what_to_order: Carts the Travel Oregon guide names there: Potato Champion, El Brasero, Burger Ritual and Pyro Pizza.
eats.why: Southeast Portland food-cart pod with a beer garden, listed among the city's classic pods.
eats.open_evidence: Travel Oregon's food-cart pod guide, originally published September 10, 2024 and shown as updated June 11, 2026, lists it as a current pod (viewed 2026-10-14); I did not reach a page from the pod itself, and individual carts change.

eats.name: Brooklyn Carreta
eats.what_to_order: Carts the Travel Oregon guide names there: Tierra del Sol, Havana Station, Bollywood Dhaba and Korean Tiger.
eats.why: Southeast Portland pod that took in carts relocated from Portland Mercado, which the guide says was fire-damaged in 2024.
eats.open_evidence: Travel Oregon's food-cart pod guide, shown as updated June 11, 2026, lists it among newer and relocated pods (viewed 2026-10-14); I did not reach a page from the pod itself, and individual carts change.

eats.name: Public Coast Brewing Co.
eats.what_to_order: Fresh-catch fish and chips, organic burgers or seasonal fresh-catch tacos, with hand-battered sweet onion rings.
eats.why: Cannon Beach brewery at 264 Third Street that says it runs its own farm growing blueberries, peaches, lavender and hops for its beverages.
eats.open_evidence: Own website says the brewery is celebrating its 10th anniversary in 2026 and lists a current food menu (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: The Lazy Susan Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Omelettes (Travel Oregon says they come in almost every imaginable way), and at lunch warm stews, French baguettes and salads.
eats.why: Small downtown cafe at 126 N Hemlock Street whose own tagline is "Our kitchen is small, but our hearts are BIG!"
eats.hours_note: Own site lists Wednesday-Monday 8AM-2:30PM and Tuesday CLOSED.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists hours but shows no year (weak); Travel Oregon's page for it shows visitor reviews from 2026 (viewed 2026-10-14).
eats.source_name: Travel Oregon (hours from the cafe's own website)

eats.name: Local Ocean Seafoods
eats.what_to_order: Fishwives Stew, Crab Cakes, Steamer Clams or Moqueca De Peixe, plus halibut, black cod or albacore when on the menu.
eats.why: Restaurant and fish market on the Bayfront at 213 SE Bay Blvd; its site says it runs a 100% Fish Program to use whole fish and is held in a Perpetual Purpose Trust.
eats.hours_note: Fall and winter hours starting Sept 8, 2026: restaurant 11am-8pm (9pm Fri and Sat), fish market 10am-8pm; closed Thanksgiving and Christmas. The site notes a 4.5% hospitality charge on in-house dining effective July 1, 2026.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists fall/winter hours "Starting Sept 8, 2026" and a charge effective July 1, 2026 (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: The Waterfront Depot
eats.what_to_order: The site calls it "Elevated Coastal Cuisine"; the dinner menu is posted as images, so I could not read individual dishes.
eats.why: Dinner-only restaurant at 1252 Bay Street in Florence.
eats.hours_note: Own site: "Open 3-9 pm daily"; indoor and outdoor seating.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a dinner menu labelled "Revised August 2026" and lists hours (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Tony's Crab Shack
eats.what_to_order: Fish tacos, crab sandwiches, grilled halibut or smoked salmon alfredo.
eats.why: Open since 1989 at 155 1st St on the waterfront; the site says David Hisel took over from founder Tony Roszkowski in January 2023, and sister business Port O'Call rents crabbing rings and boats and will clean and cook your catch.
eats.hours_note: Crab Shack 11 am-7 pm daily (Port O'Call 8 am-7 pm); closed Thanksgiving, Christmas and Easter; limited hours 10:30 am-3 pm on Christmas Eve.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and holiday closures and describes a January 2023 ownership change, but shows no copyright year (weak) (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Face Rock Creamery
eats.what_to_order: Its own cheeses such as Vampire Slayer Garlic Cheddar, plus Umpqua ice cream, flatbread pizza, sandwiches and giant pretzels with beer cheese.
eats.why: Cheesemaker and cafe at 680 2nd Street SE in Bandon; it has one other cafe, in Coos Bay.
eats.hours_note: Bandon creamery: Daily 9:00am-6:00pm (own site).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, menu and a Coos Bay cafe, but the footer shows no year (weak) (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Reading Terminal Market
eats.what_to_order: The market's own merchant page lists DiNic's hot roast beef and pork sandwiches, Beiler's Bakery sticky buns and pies, and country cooking at Down Home Diner.
eats.why: A working public food hall at 1136 Arch Street where you can eat breakfast, lunch and dessert from separate stalls in one stop.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 8AM-6PM per the market's own site; it was closed Monday September 7 for Labor Day.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists daily 8AM-6PM hours and an events page with 2026 dates (Scrapple & Apple Festival October 17, 2026; Oyster Fest November 5, 2026) (viewed 2026-10-15)

eats.name: John's Roast Pork
eats.what_to_order: The Roast Pork Sandwich, the Ultimate Cheesesteak or the Roast Beef Sandwich, the three items on its menu page.
eats.why: In South Philadelphia at Weccacoe and Snyder Avenue rather than Center City; a family-run roast pork sandwich shop that says it has served since 1930 and is run by the third generation of the Bucci family.
eats.hours_note: Open Tuesday-Saturday 10 AM-5 PM; closed Sunday and Monday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current Tuesday-Saturday hours and shows a 2026-dated seasonal promotional image and a 2025 tribute post (viewed 2026-10-15)

eats.name: Oyster House
eats.what_to_order: Sherried snapper soup and fried oysters, both named on its site; the James Beard Foundation also names crab cakes and butterscotch pudding.
eats.why: Named a 2026 James Beard America's Classics winner, family-owned since 1947 and described by the Foundation as the last of Philadelphia's legendary seafood restaurants of its generation.
eats.hours_note: Tuesday-Thursday 11:30am-9pm, Friday-Saturday 11:30am-10pm; closed Sunday and Monday. Reservations are taken through OpenTable.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and shows the 2026 America's Classics seal; James Beard Foundation's 2026 America's Classics page names Oyster House (viewed 2026-10-15)

eats.name: Lancaster Central Market
eats.what_to_order: Visit Lancaster's July 2026 guide lists scrapple, smoked sausage, cup cheese, chow-chow, whoopie pies and shoo-fly pie.
eats.why: Described by Visit Lancaster as the oldest continuously operated public market in the United States, with about 60 vendors selling Pennsylvania Dutch and international prepared foods.
eats.hours_note: Open Tuesday, Friday and Saturday only, 6AM-3PM; closed other days.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists Tuesday/Friday/Saturday 6AM-3PM hours; Visit Lancaster County's guide dated July 8, 2026 lists it as open (viewed 2026-10-15)

eats.name: Dienner's Country Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: Pennsylvania Dutch home cooking; its site names roast beef in gravy, mashed potatoes, buttered noodles, scrapple, sausage gravy and cooked oatmeal, plus themed buffets.
eats.why: In the village of Ronks on Route 30 rather than Lancaster city itself; Visit Lancaster's July 2026 guide recommends it for breakfast and its seasonal buffet as a Saturday institution.
eats.hours_note: Monday-Thursday and Saturday 7am-6pm, Friday 7am-7pm, closed Sunday and select holidays.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu (the page shows no year); Visit Lancaster County's guide dated July 8, 2026 lists it as a recommended place (viewed 2026-10-15)

eats.name: Achenbach's Pastries
eats.what_to_order: Long Johns and daily-flavour donuts, both named on its retail page.
eats.why: In Leola, a neighbouring town east of Lancaster rather than the city itself; Visit Lancaster's July 2026 guide points to its long-glazed donuts and sticky buns and an original recipe from 1955.
eats.hours_note: Monday-Friday 5:30am-5pm, Saturday 5:30am-3pm, closed Sunday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and products (the page shows no year); Visit Lancaster County's guide dated July 8, 2026 lists it as a recommended place (viewed 2026-10-15)

eats.name: Gettysburg Baking Company
eats.what_to_order: Its site lists the Chocolate Croissant, the Morning Roll (a Danish with vanilla and orange sugar), the Seeded Twist and Levain as best sellers.
eats.why: A European-style bakery right on Lincoln Square (it also has a second shop in Biglerville) for a pastry and bread stop before or after the battlefield.
eats.hours_note: Gettysburg shop at 17 Lincoln Square: Tuesday-Saturday 8am-3pm; closed Sunday and Monday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright and current hours for both shops (viewed 2026-10-15)

eats.name: Dobbin House Tavern
eats.what_to_order: Its site does not name specific dishes; it lists the casual Springhouse Tavern and the fine-dining Alexander Dobbin dining rooms, plus an in-house bakery.
eats.why: Dines in an 1776 house on the National Register of Historic Places at 89 Steinwehr Avenue, which celebrated its 250th anniversary with events in August 2026.
eats.hours_note: Per its own site: Springhouse Tavern 11am-9pm daily, first-come first-served; Alexander Dobbin dining rooms Monday-Friday 5-9pm and Saturday-Sunday 4-9pm, reservations recommended.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current dining hours (the page shows no year); Gettysburg Connection article dated August 24, 2026 reports the house's 250th-anniversary events held in 2026 (viewed 2026-10-15)

eats.name: Enrico Biscotti Company
eats.what_to_order: Its site names hand-shaped biscotti, cookies, macaroons and tortas, plus its own coffee blend.
eats.why: A single-location Italian bakery at 2022 Penn Avenue in the Strip District, listed in Visit Pittsburgh's Strip District guide.
eats.hours_note: Bakery Monday-Saturday 8am-4pm, Sunday 9am-4pm; cafe Friday 11am-2pm and Saturday 11am-3pm, no reservations.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current bakery and cafe hours (the page shows no year); Visit Pittsburgh's Strip District guide, which carries a 2026 copyright footer, lists it (viewed 2026-10-15)

eats.name: The Fallingwater Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Its page names house-made sweets, snacks to go, locally sourced coffee and bagged lunches (Lunch to Go) made with Laurel Highlands ingredients.
eats.why: In nearby Mill Run at Fallingwater rather than in Ohiopyle itself, the practical lunch stop for the Fallingwater and Kentuck Knob day.
eats.hours_note: Closed Wednesdays per Fallingwater's page. Meadow Lunch seatings are at 11am or 1pm for groups of up to six, must be paired with a tour and booked up to 48 hours ahead; the cafe is cashless.
eats.open_evidence: Fallingwater's own dining page states the Wednesday closure and current Meadow Lunch and Lunch to Go booking rules and links a menu file labelled 072026 (the page shows no visible date) (viewed 2026-10-15)

eats.name: Angelo's Civita Farnese
eats.what_to_order: The website lists lasagna, braciola, homemade meatballs and gravy, and mini cannoli.
eats.why: A family Italian-American comfort-food restaurant right on Atwells Avenue, the Federal Hill strip the itinerary sends you to.
eats.hours_note: Closed Monday and Tuesday; Wed-Thu 11:30am-8pm, Fri-Sat 11:30am-9pm, Sun 12pm-8pm (per its website)
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu and shows 2025 award banners, though its footer reads 2022 (viewed 2026-10-15)

eats.name: Sicilia's Pizzeria
eats.what_to_order: The website highlights its original deep dish stuffed pizza.
eats.why: A family-owned pizzeria on Atwells Avenue in Federal Hill, open until 2am or 3am, so it works after an evening at WaterFire.
eats.hours_note: Sun-Thu 10am-2am, Fri-Sat 10am-3am (per its website)
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists hours and menu, and its footer reads copyrighted 2025 (viewed 2026-10-15)

eats.name: Franklin Spa
eats.what_to_order: Visit Newport RI names the lobster eggs benedict, the Portuguese Sailor (eggs, chourico and cheese on Portuguese sweet bread) and stuffed French toast.
eats.why: A breakfast diner at Spring and Franklin streets that says it has served Newport breakfast for over 180 years.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 6am-1pm, closed only on Christmas, first-come first-served (per its website)
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists daily hours and online ordering but shows no year; Visit Newport RI's brunch guide dated 2026-06-18 (updated 2026-06-28) lists it as a current pick (viewed 2026-10-15)
eats.source_name: Venue's own website; Visit Newport RI brunch guide (2026)

eats.name: The Hungry Monkey
eats.what_to_order: Visit Newport RI names the Chimpanzee, a sweet bread French toast with peanut butter and banana; the cafe's own site also mentions the King Kong omelet challenge.
eats.why: A Portuguese-leaning breakfast and lunch diner on Newport's Broadway, away from the Thames Street crowds.
eats.hours_note: Breakfast and lunch daily, plus dinner Friday-Saturday (per Visit Newport RI, June 2026)
eats.open_evidence: Own website describes the cafe as serving breakfast and lunch daily but shows no year; Visit Newport RI's brunch guide dated 2026-06-18 (updated 2026-06-28) lists it as open daily (viewed 2026-10-15)
eats.source_name: Venue's own website; Visit Newport RI brunch guide (2026)

stops.note: Seasonal: per its website, Olympia Tea Room is closing for the season on Sunday, October 25. Our advice: if you reach Watch Hill after that date, expect the village to be much quieter and check what is open before you drive out.

eats.name: Olympia Tea Room
eats.what_to_order: Watch Hill Guide's 2026 review names the lobster salad croissant at lunch, the Portuguese baked haddock at dinner, and the calamari and chowders.
eats.why: Watch Hill's oldest restaurant, on Bay Street since 1916 and run by the same family since 1980 per Watch Hill Guide.
eats.hours_note: Seasonal: its website says closing for the season on Sunday, October 25 (the page shows no year). Closed Monday-Wednesday; Thu 4-8pm, Fri-Sat 12-9pm, Sun 12-8pm. No reservations.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and the October 25 season-closing banner, with no year shown; Watch Hill Guide's review, updated 2026-05-26, describes the 2026 season (viewed 2026-10-15)
eats.source_name: Venue's own website; Watch Hill Guide (2026)

stops.note: Per the Block Island Chamber of Commerce 'Who is open' page, headed 'September/October 2026. As of 10/15/26', several restaurants are in their last days or weeks of the season (Aldo's Restaurant 10/13-10/16, Winfield's tentatively October 17, Virginica Pizza and Poor People's Pub October 31, Eli's November 28). Odd Fellows Cafe, Ellen's at The Airport, McAloon's and Wetherbee's Pizza & Bar are listed as open all year. Our advice: check the chamber page for your sailing date, as more places close each week in the fall.

eats.name: Odd Fellows Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Edible Rhody (March 2026) mentions its chocolate chip and oatmeal raisin cookies.
eats.why: A year-round cafe on Water Street, which Edible Rhody says stays open all winter, with hours that suit a morning ferry arrival.
eats.hours_note: Chamber lists 'Open all year. 7:00 TO 3:00.'
eats.open_evidence: Block Island Chamber of Commerce 'Who is open' page headed 'September/October 2026. As of 10/15/26' lists it open all year; Edible Rhody article dated 2026-03-21 also lists it as year-round (viewed 2026-10-15)
eats.source_name: Block Island Chamber of Commerce; Edible Rhody (2026)

eats.name: Ellen's at The Airport
eats.what_to_order: The sources name no specific dishes; Edible Rhody describes a breakfast and lunch menu.
eats.why: A breakfast and lunch spot at the island airport that stays open year-round, per Edible Rhody; it opened in 2022, so it is newer than most places here.
eats.hours_note: Chamber lists 'Open all year. Monday-Sunday 7am-2pm. Kitchen closes at 1:30.'
eats.open_evidence: Block Island Chamber of Commerce 'Who is open' page headed 'September/October 2026. As of 10/15/26' lists it open all year; Edible Rhody article dated 2026-03-21 also lists it (viewed 2026-10-15)
eats.source_name: Block Island Chamber of Commerce; Edible Rhody (2026)

eats.name: McAloon's
eats.what_to_order: Edible Rhody (March 2026) mentions its clam chowder and French onion soup.
eats.why: One of the few island restaurants that stays open all year, per Edible Rhody, with dinner Tuesday-Saturday and lunch on Saturday and Sunday.
eats.hours_note: Chamber lists 'Open all year. Closed Mondays. Tuesday-Friday 4:00pm-8:30pm. Saturday 11:30am-8:30pm. Sunday 11:00am-3:00pm.'
eats.open_evidence: Block Island Chamber of Commerce 'Who is open' page headed 'September/October 2026. As of 10/15/26' lists it open all year; Edible Rhody article dated 2026-03-21 also lists it (viewed 2026-10-15)
eats.source_name: Block Island Chamber of Commerce; Edible Rhody (2026)
