eats.name: Thaan Aoan
eats.what_to_order: Fruit waffle and cream, fresh fruit pancakes, khao tom (rice porridge) and khao soi, per the venue's own pages.
eats.why: A family-run cafe inside the Old City moat near Wat Chedi Luang (154/5 Phra Pokklao Rd) that bakes its bread, waffles and pastries upstairs each morning, so it suits the Day 5 temple walk.
eats.hours_note: Daily 7:00am to 9:00pm, as stated on its own pages.
eats.open_evidence: Own website cafedethaanaoan.com lists hours and a 50+ item menu with a 2026 copyright footer, and its Old City breakfast post is dated 2026 with the address and hours (viewed 2026-10-16).

eats.name: Los Cocuyos
eats.what_to_order: Tacos of suadero, longaniza, cabeza, tripa or campechano, or pastor tacos; the article also names tortas.
eats.why: A taquería at Simón Bolívar 59 in the Centro Histórico, a short walk from the Zócalo day, that El Financiero says has been open since 1980 and serves around the clock, so it fits a late arrival or a night after the museums.
eats.hours_note: Per El Financiero (23 June 2026): "abiertos las 24 horas todos los días del año". The article also gives tacos at 60-120 pesos and tortas at 80-120 pesos.
eats.open_evidence: El Financiero feature dated 2026-06-23 describes it in the present tense as open 24 hours with a Simón Bolívar 59 address (viewed 2026-10-16); no venue website was found, and the article gives a single address rather than stating a branch count.

eats.name: Expendio de Maíz
eats.what_to_order: The page names no dishes; it describes the food as "Made with corn. Made with intention" and links a drinks menu.
eats.why: A single-location kitchen at Avenida Yucatán 84 in Roma Norte that builds its cooking around corn.
eats.hours_note: Per its own Visit page: Tuesday-Thursday 9:00 am-7:00 pm, Friday and Saturday 9:00 am-8:30 pm, Sunday 9:00 am-6:00 pm, Monday closed; cash or bank transfer only.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a '(c) 2025 Expendio de Maiz' footer and current hours on its Visit page (viewed 2026-10-16); the page carries no 2026 date.

stops.note: Per Noticaribe (24 September 2026), between 10 and 15 restaurants in Playa del Carmen have closed permanently during the current low season, and other establishments have suspended operations temporarily; the article attributes this to lower tourist activity and does not mention hurricanes. Our advice: confirm a restaurant's hours on the day before you go, and treat any listing without a 2026 date with caution.

eats.name: Cochinita Pibil · Diagonal 85
eats.what_to_order: Tacos de cochinita pibil with hand-made tortillas, tortas de cochinita, and on Sundays the lechón al horno.
eats.why: A single-location cochinita stand in the Colonia Ejidal, a short way inland from Quinta Avenida rather than on the tourist strip, open from 5:30 am so it suits a pre-cenote or pre-Chichén Itzá breakfast.
eats.hours_note: Per its own site: Monday-Sunday 5:30 AM-1:00 PM or until supplies run out.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu with a '(c) 2026 Cochinita Pibil Diagonal 85' footer (viewed 2026-10-16); no closure or hurricane notice on the page.

eats.name: Carboncitos
eats.what_to_order: Yucatán dishes the site names: relleno negro, cochinita pibil and tikin xic, plus a breakfast menu of huevos motuleños and huevos rancheros.
eats.why: A single-location restaurant in the centre of Playa del Carmen near 5th Avenue serving Yucatecan and Mexican dishes at a sit-down table.
eats.hours_note: Per its own menu page: Tuesday-Sunday 7:30am-11pm, closed Mondays; the page states it accepts cash only.
eats.open_evidence: Own website and menu page carry a '(c) 2025 Carboncitos' footer with current menu prices (viewed 2026-10-16); the pages show no 2026 date and no hurricane-season notice.

eats.name: Komagata Dozeu (駒形どぜう 本店)
eats.what_to_order: Dozeu nabe (loach hot pot), listed on the menu page alongside dozeu-jiru (loach soup) and yanagawa nabe.
eats.why: A single Komagata honten near Asakusa (a short walk from Senso-ji, not inside Asakusa's temple streets) that says it has served loach dishes since 1801; the menu page lists loach and whale dishes rather than tourist-menu staples.
eats.hours_note: 11:00-20:30 (last order 20:00). Closes on irregular days; the site posts a closure list each month (the November notice is dated 2026年10月15日), so check dozeu.com/information before going.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows 'Copyright © 2026', a news item dated 2026年10月15日 giving November closure days, and a menu page with tax-inclusive prices (viewed 2026-10-16).

eats.name: Marutake (つきじ丸武)
eats.what_to_order: Freshly grilled atsuyaki tamago (thick rolled omelette) eaten at the counter, sold as 'Yaki-tama 200 yen' on the site; the page says it is not available to take away.
eats.why: A tamagoyaki specialist at the Tsukiji Outer Market that says it dates from the late Taisho era; on its own site the grilled-to-order omelette is available to eat on the spot only at the Tsukiji shop and its Toyosu Senkyaku Banrai PREMIUM shop.
eats.hours_note: Tsukiji shop: weekdays 4:00-14:00, Sundays 8:00-14:00 (alternate Sundays closed in January and August); closed on public holidays and market holidays (the site's wording: 祝日・市場休市日). The site also lists a Toyosu market shop and a Toyosu Senkyaku Banrai PREMIUM shop, so confirm you are at the Tsukiji address.
eats.open_evidence: Own website news page has an item dated 2026.6.1 and a shop-information page with current hours and the Tsukiji address (viewed 2026-10-16).

eats.name: Nishiki Hirano (錦 平野)
eats.what_to_order: The breakfast set with freshly grilled dashimaki (rolled omelette) and a dashi chazuke to finish; at lunch the tempura set meal or the beef dashimaki-jū set, per the home page.
eats.why: A delicatessen in Nishiki Market that describes itself as over a hundred years old and has a 50-seat eat-in room behind the shopfront; the page notes you cannot eat while walking the market street, only take away or sit inside.
eats.hours_note: Eat-in 08:30-10:15 (last order 10:00) and 11:00-16:00 (last order for food 15:30); shop counter 08:30-19:00, closes when sold out. Open daily; closed over year-end/New Year or on temporary closure days. Breakfast and lunch can be reserved (news item dated 2026.9.17).
eats.open_evidence: Own website has news posts dated 2026.9.17, 2026.5.20 and 2026.5.4 and a store-information page stating hours and 'Open daily' (viewed 2026-10-16).

eats.name: Soirée (喫茶ソワレ)
eats.what_to_order: The jelly drinks, including Jelly Punch and Jelly Coffee, and the thick toast, which the menu says is big enough for two to share.
eats.why: A single kissaten near Shijo-Kawaramachi that says it opened in 1948; the site describes a dim room with blue lighting and no background music, and says it has served jelly drinks since the 1960s-70s.
eats.hours_note: Weekdays 13:00-19:00 (last order 18:00); Saturdays, Sundays and holidays 13:00-19:30 (last order 18:30); closed Mondays, including when Monday is a holiday. The site says one order per person is required.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows news dated 2026年9月22日 (opening calendar for 6 October to 1 November) and 2026年9月8日, plus current hours and menu prices (viewed 2026-10-16); the footer reads 2024.

eats.name: Mizuno (美津の)
eats.what_to_order: Okonomiyaki, including the mixed (pork, squid, shrimp, scallop, octopus and minced meat) and the yamaimo-yaki made with 100% mountain yam, per the menu page.
eats.why: A single okonomiyaki restaurant just inside the arcade off Dotonbori that says it has run for over 70 years on the same spot.
eats.hours_note: 11:00-22:00 (last order 21:00), 'no regular holiday' per the shop page. Weekday-only lunch service 11:00-15:00 except Golden Week, Obon and year-end/New Year. Home page notice: from February 2026 the former Thursday closure no longer applies.
eats.open_evidence: Own website home page carries a notice about the schedule change 'from February 2026' and states current hours and phone number (viewed 2026-10-16); the page shows no copyright year.

eats.name: Ajinoya (味乃家)
eats.what_to_order: Okonomiyaki and yakisoba; the site's title names both.
eats.why: A Namba okonomiyaki restaurant with three shops (main shop, Ajinoya Hanare, and the Yondaime Ajinoya that opened 31 July 2026); the main shop is in Namba, a short walk from Dotonbori.
eats.hours_note: Main shop 11:00-22:00 Tuesday-Sunday and holidays; closed Mondays per the business-hours table. The site uses a FastPass slot system and says reservations through AutoReserve are not accepted. Check the site's holiday calendar.
eats.open_evidence: Own website news archive shows 'Fri, Jul 31 NEW OPEN! July 31, 2026: Yondaime Ajinoya' and 'Apr 03 Notice of Menu Revision', and a holiday calendar for October and November 2026 (viewed 2026-10-16).

eats.name: Meşhur Filibe Köftecisi
eats.what_to_order: Meşhur Filibe Köftesi, with piyaz; the site also lists sütlaç, revani and buffalo yoghurt.
eats.why: In Sirkeci, on Hocapaşa Lokantaları Sokağı, a short way from the old-city sights; the site says it has one location only ("Başka Şubemiz Yoktur") and traces its recipe to 1893.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer, a current phone and email, and the menu items above (viewed 2026-10-16); the page lists no opening hours.

eats.name: Yanyalı Fehmi Lokantası
eats.what_to_order: Yanya köfte (meatballs wrapped in eggplant slices and baked with tomatoes) and roasted eggplant puree, both named on the site.
eats.why: In Kadıköy rather than the old city, so it suits an evening away from Sultanahmet; the site describes a family restaurant started in 1919 that now runs from this one location only.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer and a current contact page with phone number (viewed 2026-10-16); the pages seen list no opening hours.

eats.name: Gurme Kebab
eats.what_to_order: Testi kebabı (clay pot kebab), which the site says needs advance notice because of a 3-4 hour cooking time; the menu also lists grilled kebabs, pides and desserts such as baklava and künefe.
eats.why: A single-location Anatolian restaurant on Müze Caddesi in the middle of Göreme, listing a clay pot kebab among its dishes.
eats.hours_note: Site states Saturday-Thursday 9:00-23:30 and Friday 13:30-23:30; it also says hours may vary and that reservations are recommended in peak season.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer, current hours and a 99-item menu with prices in lira (viewed 2026-10-16).

eats.name: Meğri Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: Desti kebap (sealed-pot dish from the Yozgat region), which the site names as its specialty; the menu also lists fresh fish, kebabs and meze.
eats.why: A single Fethiye restaurant whose site describes seafood, steaks and local dishes, with a large printed menu and a wine cellar.
eats.hours_note: Site states Monday-Saturday 10:00-24:00 and Sunday 10:00-22:00; no seasonal closing dates are stated.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer, current hours and a menu with lira prices (viewed 2026-10-16).

eats.name: Şef Meze Balık
eats.what_to_order: Fish and meze, which the site names as its focus.
eats.why: A single-location fish-and-meze restaurant in central Fethiye (Cumhuriyet Mahallesi) that describes itself as aiming to be the new destination for meze and fish in Fethiye.
eats.open_evidence: Own website is live with a 2026 copyright footer, address and phone number; the page lists no opening hours or seasonal dates (viewed 2026-10-16).

eats.name: Callie's Hot Little Biscuit
eats.what_to_order: Biscuits, pimento cheese, slow-cooked grits and French press coffee, all listed on the Upper King page.
eats.why: A grab-and-go biscuit shop on King Street, one of the small grab-and-go eateries the Charleston biscuit company runs, per its own site.
eats.hours_note: Upper King (476 1/2 King St) lists 'Open daily, 8AM - 2PM'.
eats.open_evidence: Own website location page lists current daily hours and online/curbside ordering, and its footer reads 2026 (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Poogan's Porch
eats.what_to_order: Southern and Lowcountry cooking; the site describes brunch daily and dinner daily but names no individual dishes.
eats.why: A restored Victorian house in the historic district that has been serving Southern food since 1976.
eats.hours_note: Brunch daily 9:00am-3:00pm; dinner daily 4:30pm-9:30pm. Thanksgiving and Christmas 11am-9pm, prix fixe menu only (2025-2026 holiday schedule on the site).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current brunch/dinner hours, a 2025-2026 holiday schedule and a Southern Living Legendary Restaurants 2026 mention (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Bowens Island Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: Steamed local oysters (from 4:00pm), raw oysters, boiled shrimp and fried shrimp, per the restaurant's own page.
eats.why: On Bowens Island off James Island rather than on the peninsula; a waterfront oyster-and-shrimp house that has been open since 1946 per the Charleston City Paper.
eats.hours_note: Own site lists Tue-Thu 11am-9pm and Fri-Sat 11am-9:30pm, with steamed oysters from 4pm; it lists no Sunday or Monday hours. Own page shows no year.
eats.open_evidence: Post and Courier's 2026-27 oyster-roast listing (published 2026-10-01) lists six events hosted at Bowens Island Restaurant from Oct 25 2026 to Jan 24 2027; own site lists current hours but shows no copyright year (viewed 2026-10-15).
eats.source_name: Venue's own website; Post and Courier oyster-roast listing (2026-10-01)

eats.name: Hudson's Seafood House on the Docks
eats.what_to_order: Oysters (raw and cooked), shrimp and, in season, soft shell crabs, per the site's own annual figures.
eats.why: Hilton Head's oldest seafood restaurant, on a working dock, with more than 90% of its seafood from local boats per its own site.
eats.hours_note: Mon-Sat 11:00am-9:30pm, Sun 10:00am-9:30pm (Sunday brunch 10am-2pm). Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day and Super Bowl Sunday. First come, first served; no reservations or call-aheads.
eats.open_evidence: Own website footer reads 2026 and lists current hours and holiday closures (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Harold's Diner
eats.what_to_order: Breakfast (7:30-11am) and lunch (11am-3pm) are served; the page names no specific dishes.
eats.why: A no-frills diner on William Hilton Parkway for an early breakfast on the island.
eats.hours_note: Mon-Fri 7:30am-3pm (breakfast until 11am, lunch from 11am); Saturday 7:30am-noon, breakfast only.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and its footer reads 2025 (viewed 2026-10-15); no 2026 date on the page.

eats.name: Henry's Smokehouse
eats.what_to_order: Hickory-smoked pork butts and ribs; the site says pork cooks about 12 hours and ribs over 8 hours on open pits.
eats.why: A local barbecue house on Wade Hampton Blvd. that cooks over hickory logs on open pits; it has two restaurants (Greenville and Simpsonville) plus a food truck.
eats.hours_note: Mon-Sat 11:00am-8:00pm, Sun 11:00am-3:00pm at both restaurants.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours at both locations and its footer reads 2026 (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Lewis Barbecue
eats.what_to_order: Brisket, ribs and other smoked meats; the site describes counter-order Central Texas-style barbecue.
eats.why: Central Texas-style barbecue rather than Carolina-style, from a small group with three locations (Atlanta, Charleston, Greenville) and custom pits visible at the entrance.
eats.hours_note: Greenville: Sun-Thu 11am-9pm, Fri-Sat 11am-10pm. Counter order, no reservations needed.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current Greenville hours and states a 2025 Michelin Guide recognition; the page shows no copyright year, so the evidence is weaker than for a dated page (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Swamp Rabbit Brewery & Taproom
eats.what_to_order: Its own beers on tap, such as the Honey Bunny amber ale, Swamp Rabbit Trail Pale Ale or the Oktoberfest lager; the page also lists snacks and says food trucks appear at events.
eats.why: A craft taproom on Main Street at the northern end of the Swamp Rabbit Trail; it does not run a full kitchen, so pair it with a meal elsewhere in town.
eats.hours_note: Closed Mondays; Tue-Wed 12-8pm, Thu-Sat 12-9pm, Sun 12-7pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website tap list is marked 'Last Updated October 10, 2026' (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Whistle Stop at the American Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Shrimp and grits and fried green tomatoes; the page also names burgers, pizzas and strawberry and carrot cake.
eats.why: A family-owned restaurant at 109 S. Main St. on the Swamp Rabbit Trail, in operation since 1945 per its own site.
eats.hours_note: Own site: Mon-Thu 11am-8:30pm, Fri-Sat 11am-9:30pm, Sun 11am-3pm; live music Friday and Saturday April-October. The Town of Travelers Rest listing gives Sunday as closed, so confirm Sunday hours.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu but shows no copyright year; the Town of Travelers Rest restaurant page (footer 2026) lists it with hours (viewed 2026-10-15).
eats.source_name: Venue's own website; Town of Travelers Rest restaurant page

eats.name: Skogen Kitchen
eats.what_to_order: The menu is chef-driven and changes often, so order from whatever the current menu offers.
eats.why: A chef-driven Custer kitchen whose own site shows James Beard Award semifinalist seals for 2023 and 2025, a rare find in a small Black Hills town.
eats.hours_note: Dinner Tuesday-Saturday, 5:00-8:30 PM per its own website; reservations are available through the site.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current dinner hours and shows a 2025 James Beard semifinalist seal; Travel South Dakota's Custer State Park dining page lists it as year-round (page shows no year) (viewed 2026-10-15).

stops.note: Per Travel South Dakota, Cedar Pass Lodge & Restaurant, the only restaurant inside Badlands National Park, is listed with a season of April 15 to October 31 (the page shows no year). Our advice: on a day spent on the Badlands Loop Road, plan to eat in Wall rather than inside the park, and check the lodge's season before counting on it late in the year.

eats.name: Wall Drug Store Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Buffalo burgers, homemade donuts, hot beef sandwiches and the 5-cent coffee, all named on its own site.
eats.why: The roadside institution at the north-east gateway to Badlands National Park, with a 530-seat Western Art Gallery Restaurant.
eats.hours_note: Cafe 8:00 AM-5:00 PM daily per its own visit page (Travel South Dakota lists longer hours; the venue's own page is followed here).
eats.open_evidence: Own website visit page lists current cafe hours and shows a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: The Latchstring Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: The signature Trout Almondine, breakfast skillets, burgers and weekly rotating pasta, per its own site.
eats.why: In Spearfish Canyon itself on the scenic byway (mailing address Lead, SD, not Spearfish town); its own site says the restaurant has operated since 1909.
eats.hours_note: Own site: Sunday-Wednesday 7 AM-8 PM, Thursday-Saturday 7 AM-9 PM, and states it operates year-round (Travel South Dakota's listing gives 7 AM-9 PM daily; the venue's own hours are given here).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and a weekly specials menu, states year-round operation, and its footer shows 2026 (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Phillips Avenue Diner
eats.what_to_order: The Pork Fritter from its autumn feature menu (its Downtown Pork Showdown entry), per the October 2026 roundup.
eats.why: A retro downtown diner whose own site traces it to the Market Diner on Louise Avenue from 1996 and a silver Airstream trailer.
eats.hours_note: Travel South Dakota says open seven days a week; specific hours were not confirmed on a fetched page, so check before going. The autumn feature menu is a seasonal special.
eats.open_evidence: Pigeon605 restaurant roundup dated 2026-10-05 reports the diner's new autumn feature menu; its own site and Travel South Dakota's listing also describe it as current (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: M.B. Haskett Delicatessen
eats.what_to_order: Travel South Dakota's description names crepes, cappuccino, quiche and muffaletta.
eats.why: A downtown deli with a rotating menu from breakfast through dinner, a flexible stop for a day split between Falls Park and the downtown sculptures.
eats.hours_note: Open daily for breakfast, lunch and dinner; kitchen closed 2-5 PM Friday, Saturday and Sunday, per Travel South Dakota (page shows no year).
eats.open_evidence: SiouxFalls.Business restaurant roundup dated 2026-06-25 reports a new summer dinner menu; Travel South Dakota's listing gives current hours (page shows no year) (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Bread & Vine Bistro
eats.what_to_order: Sourdough bread (baked Wednesday and Saturday), biscuits and gravy, paninis, scones and cheesecakes, per the Mitchell Republic.
eats.why: A downtown Main Street cafe in a space that has been a cafe since 2007, reopened under new owners Jeff and Denise Del Favero on April 11, 2025.
eats.hours_note: Visit Mitchell lists it closed Sunday; its weekday hours are listed inconsistently (Monday-Friday 7 AM-4 PM and Tuesday and Saturday 8 AM-4 PM), so call 605-990-2233 before going.
eats.open_evidence: Mitchell Republic article dated 2025-04-29 reports it opened 2025-04-11; Visit Mitchell's tourism listing shows hours but no year (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: The Depot
eats.what_to_order: Burgers, steaks and BBQ, per Visit Mitchell; its own site also names soups and homemade desserts.
eats.why: A gastropub in the 1909 Chicago, Milwaukee and St. Paul Railroad depot, seven blocks south of the Corn Palace.
eats.hours_note: Closed Sunday per both its own site and Visit Mitchell; weekday hours differ between the two (own site 11 AM-9 PM Monday-Thursday, Visit Mitchell 11:30 AM-10 PM), so call 605-996-9417.
eats.open_evidence: Mitchell Area Chamber of Commerce events page shows a live-music night at The Depot on 2025-11-26; own website and Visit Mitchell listing show current hours (neither shows a year) (viewed 2026-10-15).
eats.source_name: Visit Mitchell; venue's own website; Mitchell Area Chamber of Commerce

eats.name: Arnold's Country Kitchen
eats.what_to_order: Meat-and-three fare; its own site names roasted beef, long-simmered greens, fried green tomatoes and cornbread.
eats.why: A weekday-lunch meat-and-three counter at 605 8th Avenue South that its own site credits with a 2009 James Beard America's Classics award.
eats.hours_note: Own site: Monday-Friday 10:30 AM-2:45 PM; Saturday 11 AM-3 PM (brunch); closed December 24-27 and January 1. Its hours page shows no year.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current weekday and Saturday hours and holiday closures but shows no year; a 2026 Nashville Scene readers' poll page names it, which shows it was operating in 2026 (both viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: The Butter Milk Ranch
eats.what_to_order: Croissants, cookies and pastries from the bakery counter, or pancakes and breakfast bowls in the dining room, per its visit page.
eats.why: A single-location small-batch bakery and day-dining room at 2407 12th Ave S whose site says brunch is served all day, every day.
eats.hours_note: Own site: bakery and counter service Tuesday-Sunday 8am-4pm; full-service dining room Tuesday-Sunday 8am-3pm; closed Mondays.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu but shows no year; a 2026 Nashville Scene readers' poll page names it, which shows it was operating in 2026 (both viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: The Loveless Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Fried chicken, country ham, pulled pork BBQ and biscuits, all named on its own site.
eats.why: A single cafe that says it has been serving since 1951, open for breakfast through dinner every day.
eats.hours_note: Own site: Monday-Friday 8am-9pm; Saturday-Sunday 7am-9pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and promotes Thanksgiving meal pre-orders; the page shows no visible copyright year, but its hours graphic was uploaded in 2026/03 per the page source (viewed 2026-10-14).

stops.note: Per the National Park Service, limited food and beverage services, groceries, and convenience items are available in the park visitor centers and, during peak season, at the Cades Cove store. Our advice: plan meals in Gatlinburg around park days rather than counting on the park for a sit-down meal.

eats.name: Pancake Pantry
eats.what_to_order: Its site names no specific dishes; it says the breakfast menu is available all day and the lunch menu starts after 11:30am.
eats.why: A pancake house on the Parkway itself (628 Parkway), handy for a morning on the strip before heading into the park.
eats.hours_note: Own site: open daily 7am-3pm; closed Thanksgiving and Christmas.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists hours and carries a 'Copyright 2026 Pancake Pantry' footer (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Wild Plum Tea Room
eats.what_to_order: Its site lists seafood specials, sandwiches, a signature chicken salad, soups and desserts, and mentions a lobster pie.
eats.why: A small lunch-only tea room at 555 Buckhorn Road in Gatlinburg's Arts & Crafts Community, away from the Parkway crowds.
eats.hours_note: Open Thursday, Friday and Saturday only, 11am-3pm. Advance reservations only (no walk-ins or same-day reservations); text or call 865-436-3808. Closed Thanksgiving Day (Nov 26, 2026) and for the season from Sunday Nov 29, 2026 until mid-March 2027.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists reservations through Nov 28, 2026 and a 2026 season closing date, with a 'Copyright 2026' footer (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Smoky Mountain Trout House
eats.what_to_order: Local trout fried, baked, blackened or bacon-stuffed; its site also lists chicken, catfish and shrimp.
eats.why: A single-location dinner restaurant at 410 Parkway that calls itself locally owned and operated and says it has served since 1975.
eats.hours_note: Own site: open daily 3:00 PM-9:00 PM. The page shows no visible year.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists daily hours and a current menu; it shows no visible year, but the page source carries CMS updated-at timestamps of 2026-03-13 (viewed 2026-10-14). This is weaker evidence than a dated footer.

eats.name: The Old Mill Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: Pancakes and French toast at breakfast and Southern-style lunch and dinner plates; its site says the kitchen makes 2,500 biscuits and 120 pecan pies daily.
eats.why: A riverside Southern restaurant on Old Mill Avenue in Pigeon Forge serving breakfast, lunch and dinner every day.
eats.hours_note: Own site: breakfast daily 8-11am, lunch 11am-4pm, dinner 4-9:30pm; no reservations accepted. No closure dates were listed for 2026.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists daily meal hours and carries a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-14).

stops.note: Per the National Park Service, limited food and beverage services, groceries, and convenience items are available in the park visitor centers and, during peak season, at the Cades Cove store. Our advice: eat in Townsend before or after the Cades Cove Loop rather than relying on the park for a meal.

eats.name: Burger Master Drive-In
eats.what_to_order: Burgers, hot dogs and Mayfield soft-serve ice cream, milkshakes and banana splits, all listed on its site.
eats.why: A single-location drive-in at 8439 State Hwy 73 whose site says it has been a staple of the valley for generations, a quick stop near the Cades Cove end of the park.
eats.hours_note: Seasonal. Fall hours Sept 8-Nov 1: open Wednesday-Sunday, closed Monday and Tuesday; Wed/Thu/Sun grill and ice cream 11am-8pm; Fri/Sat grill 11am-8pm, ice cream until 9pm. Closed for the season from Nov 2 until March (date TBD); the site says 'See you in March 2027!'.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists the fall 2026 schedule and a March 2027 reopening message (viewed 2026-10-14, a Wednesday inside the Sept 8-Nov 1 window).

eats.name: Riverstone Family Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: Its site shows burgers, steaks, sandwiches, fried chicken, fish and breakfast items such as French toast.
eats.why: A family restaurant at 8503 TN-73 on the national-park end of Townsend that says it has operated since 2004 and serves breakfast, lunch and dinner.
eats.hours_note: Own site: daily 7:30 AM-10:00 PM, stated as year-round.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists daily hours and address; it shows no visible year, but the page source carries 2026 dates including a 2026-10-06 timestamp (viewed 2026-10-14). This is weaker evidence than a dated footer.

stops.note: Dining inside Big Bend is thin: the NPS dining page says the Mountain View Restaurant in the Chisos Basin is closed, with a food truck outside the main Lodge building; packaged food and drinks are sold at Castolon, the Chisos Basin and Rio Grande Village, and Hikers Lunches are available for picnicking. Full meals are outside the park in Terlingua and Study Butte. Our advice: plan trail-day food in advance.

eats.name: Espresso y Poco Mas
eats.what_to_order: Espresso drinks and breakfast burritos, with eggs Benedict variations, pancakes and French toast also listed.
eats.why: The listing calls it the only place in Terlingua for espresso and offers to-go orders aimed at early park departures.
eats.hours_note: Listed open daily 7:30 AM to 2 PM, including Christmas morning; to-go orders available
eats.open_evidence: Visit Big Bend (Brewster County Tourism Council, page footer 2026) lists current daily hours, phone and menu highlights (viewed 2026-10-03)
eats.source_name: Visit Big Bend (Brewster County Tourism Council)

eats.name: DB's Rustic Iron BBQ
eats.what_to_order: Prime-grade brisket, St. Louis-style pork ribs, smoked turkey breast, sausage or barbacoa.
eats.why: Central Texas-style post oak barbecue served in the Terlingua Ghost Town since 1993, which the listing says moved to a new permanent location in 2024.
eats.hours_note: Listed open Wednesday through Monday from 11 AM until sellout; closed Tuesdays
eats.open_evidence: Visit Big Bend (Brewster County Tourism Council, page footer 2026) lists current hours and notes the 2024 relocation to a new permanent location (viewed 2026-10-03)
eats.source_name: Visit Big Bend (Brewster County Tourism Council)

eats.name: Starlight Theatre Restaurant & Saloon
eats.what_to_order: Antelope tenders, quail, brisket tacos, the Diego burger or bourbon pecan pie.
eats.why: Dinner in a restored 1939 Chisos Mining Company movie house in the Terlingua Ghost Town, with live Texas singer-songwriters from around 6 PM.
eats.hours_note: Own site lists Sun-Fri 5:00 pm-12:00 am and Sat 5:00 pm-1:00 am; reservations recommended October through April
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and phone, and Visit Big Bend (Brewster County Tourism Council, footer 2026) lists dinner nightly from 5 PM with the same menu highlights (both viewed 2026-10-03)
eats.source_name: Visit Big Bend (Brewster County Tourism Council)

eats.name: Joe's Bakery & Coffee Shop
eats.what_to_order: Huevos Rancheros Plate, Joey Rocha Breakfast or Carne Guisada Plate.
eats.why: Family-run East Austin Tex-Mex breakfast counter that the site says has operated since 1962.
eats.hours_note: Closed Mondays; Tuesday-Sunday 6:00 AM-2:00 PM; closed on holidays; breakfast all day, lunch from 10:30 AM; does not accept Apple Pay or contactless payments
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, menu prices and a 3% packaging fee notice (viewed 2026-10-03)

eats.name: Franklin Barbecue
eats.what_to_order: Brisket, pork ribs, pulled pork, turkey or sausage.
eats.why: Its site says it uses USDA Prime brisket and heritage-breed pork and sells until sold out, typically 2-3 pm, with advance pre-orders available.
eats.hours_note: Tuesday-Sunday 11am until sold out (typically 2-3pm); closed Mondays; site lists closures Nov 26-27 and Dec 25-28
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours plus upcoming events dated Oct 16-18, 2026 and upcoming holiday closures (viewed 2026-10-03)

eats.name: Matt's El Rancho
eats.what_to_order: Sizzling Angus beef fajitas, cheese enchiladas, pork tamales or Bob's Famous Queso.
eats.why: Single-location South Lamar Tex-Mex restaurant founded in 1952 that traces its roots to a 1923 tamale cart, per its own site.
eats.hours_note: Closed Tuesdays; Mon and Sun 11am-9pm, Wed-Thu 11am-10pm, Fri-Sat 11am-11pm
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu with a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-03)

eats.name: Old German Bakery & Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: Authentic German breads and pastries, or breakfast served throughout the day and the daily specials.
eats.why: Established in 1975 on West Main Street and owned since 1998 by Lutz Henschel, making traditional German recipes from scratch.
eats.hours_note: Directory lists Mon-Tue 7AM-2PM, Fri 7AM-2PM, Sat-Sun 7AM-3PM and closed Wednesday-Thursday; confirm before driving
eats.open_evidence: Fredericksburg Convention & Visitors Bureau directory (footer 2026) lists current hours, and its bakeries guide, last modified 2026-02-02, includes it (viewed 2026-10-03)

eats.name: Der Lindenbaum
eats.what_to_order: Schnitzel, steaks or sandwiches, with apfel strudel, streuselkuchen or Black Forest cake for dessert.
eats.why: German cooking in a limestone building built by Fredericksburg's German pioneers; the chef-owner trained in Germany and opened it first as a bakery.
eats.hours_note: Closed Tuesdays; both the venue and the visitors bureau list lunch and dinner service on other days
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and Rheinland lunch specials, and the Fredericksburg Visitors Bureau directory (footer 2026) lists it with hours (both viewed 2026-10-03)

eats.name: Naegelin's Bakery
eats.what_to_order: Kolaches (bratwurst, jalapeno sausage or fruit and cheese) and apple, cherry or peach strudel.
eats.why: Calls itself the oldest bakery in Texas, in business since 1868, a few steps off the New Braunfels plaza.
eats.hours_note: Monday-Friday 6:30AM-5:30PM, Saturday 6:30AM-5:00PM, Sunday 8:00AM-2:00PM
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menus (viewed 2026-10-03); a New Braunfels Herald-Zeitung feature published 2024-11-01 describes it as operating and selling strudels and sweet pretzels

eats.name: Gristmill River Restaurant & Bar
eats.what_to_order: Beef Tenderloin Salad, GristBurger or Jack Daniel's Pecan Pie a la mode.
eats.why: Dining in the ruins of an 1878 cotton gin under Gruene's water tower above the Guadalupe River, open since 1977.
eats.hours_note: Sun-Thu 11 am-9 pm, Fri-Sat 11 am-10 pm; live music in the beer garden
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and a full priced menu, with a 2025 copyright footer and current hiring and holiday-party posts (viewed 2026-10-03)

eats.name: Mi Tierra Cafe & Bakery
eats.what_to_order: The all-day breakfast of Tex-Mex, Mexican and American classics, or the comida corrida lunch specials.
eats.why: A Market Square landmark that grew from a three-table cafe in 1941, with a bakery counter.
eats.open_evidence: Own website (La Familia Cortez) announces La Gran Tamalada for September 22, 2026 at Market Square and lists current happy-hour times (viewed 2026-10-03)

eats.name: Oscar's Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Pancakes, omelets or the breakfast burrito, all named on the cafe's own site.
eats.why: A breakfast, lunch and dinner cafe in Springdale at the mouth of Zion National Park, so it works for a big breakfast before a Narrows or Angels Landing day.
eats.open_evidence: Own website footer reads 'Copyright 2015-2026 Oscar's Cafe' and announces online gift cards (viewed 2026-10-03); the site lists no hours, so confirm them before going.

eats.name: Zion Canyon Brew Pub
eats.what_to_order: Made-from-scratch pub fare with Zion Brewery beers, per the brewery's site.
eats.why: The Zion Brewery's own pub on Zion Park Blvd in Springdale, where the site lists live music, a good post-hike dinner.
eats.open_evidence: Own website links a 'Winter 2026' menu PDF and shows a 2025 copyright (viewed 2026-10-03); the page does not list Brew Pub hours.

eats.name: Cowboy's Buffet & Steak Room
eats.what_to_order: The breakfast buffet (6:30-10:00 AM) or the rotating seasonal buffet; the page also mentions a full menu.
eats.why: The old Western dining room at Ruby's Inn, which the Ruby's Inn site says has served Bryce visitors since 1916, with walk-in seating and no reservations needed.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 6:30 AM-9:30 PM May 1-Oct 15 and 6:30 AM-8:30 PM Oct 16-Apr 30; no reservations needed.
eats.open_evidence: Ruby's Inn's own site lists these seasonal hours and Christmas 2026 holiday hours (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: The Canyon Diner
eats.what_to_order: Burgers, deli sandwiches or a fresh 7 or 15 inch pizza; the page also lists shrimp and halibut baskets.
eats.why: Quick, casual lunch about a mile from the park entrance, with online ordering for pickup if you want to eat at an overlook.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 11:30 AM-9:00 PM May 1-Oct 15; 11:30 AM-7:00 PM with a reduced menu Oct 16-Apr 30; closed Christmas Eve and Christmas Day.
eats.open_evidence: Ruby's Inn's own page lists seasonal hours and online ordering (viewed 2026-10-03); the page itself carries no date, but the same site posts Christmas 2026 hours.

eats.name: Stone Hearth Grille
eats.what_to_order: Steaks and seafood from the grille; the page mentions rib eye, filet, pork chop and grilled halibut.
eats.why: A dinner-only grille in the neighbouring town of Tropic rather than Bryce Canyon City itself, on the way along Highway 12 — a step up from the diners if you want a sit-down evening.
eats.hours_note: Dinner only, open March 23-October 29, 2026 and closed for winter; reservations recommended (435-679-8923).
eats.open_evidence: Own website states 'Open March 23rd - October 29th 2026' and 'Reopening Mid-March 2026' (viewed 2026-10-03).

stops.note: Escalante is a small town, and only one eat here could be confirmed as currently operating for this guide. Visit Utah warns that along this corridor many restaurants are closed during the winter months. Our advice: check hours before relying on any meal, and carry snacks for Highway 12.

eats.name: Escalante Outfitters
eats.what_to_order: The pizza and beer the site features.
eats.why: An outfitter store, restaurant and beer stop in the middle of Escalante, so it doubles as a gear and trail-info stop for Grand Staircase-Escalante.
eats.hours_note: Restaurant 11 AM-9 PM daily and store 9 AM-9 PM daily per the site; it says 'Open for the 2026 Season' and does not state a closing date.
eats.open_evidence: Own homepage says 'Open for the 2026 Season!' and lists restaurant hours (viewed 2026-10-03).

stops.note: Boulder is a very small town on Highway 12 between Escalante and Torrey; only the two Hell's Backbone venues could be verified here. Visit Utah warns that many restaurants in this corridor close for the winter, and Hell's Backbone dinner requires a reservation.

eats.name: Little Bone Food Truck
eats.what_to_order: Breakfast or lunch from the truck; the page lists no individual dishes.
eats.why: The easy no-reservation option on a Highway 12 driving day, run by the Hell's Backbone Grill and Farm operation and serving from 7 AM.
eats.hours_note: Breakfast and lunch 7 AM-2 PM seven days a week; dinners Tuesday and Wednesday 4-8 PM.
eats.open_evidence: Hell's Backbone's own site lists these hours alongside 2026 events, including an October 14 and a November 2 event (viewed 2026-10-03).
eats.source_name: Hell's Backbone Grill & Farm (venue's own website)

eats.name: Hell's Backbone Grill
eats.what_to_order: Dinner service only; the page lists no dishes, and Visit Utah says the kitchen uses vegetables and herbs from the restaurant's own organic farm.
eats.why: A destination dinner on the Highway 12 route that pairs a grill with its own farm, worth planning the day around if you reserve ahead.
eats.hours_note: Dinner Thursday-Monday 4-9 PM; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; reservations required.
eats.open_evidence: Own site lists dinner hours, a reservation link and 2026 events (viewed 2026-10-03).
eats.source_name: Hell's Backbone Grill & Farm (venue's own website)

stops.note: Capitol Reef National Park has no restaurant or lodge, and the Gifford House in the park sells baked goods and snacks only, usually March through October. Our read: Torrey, just outside the park, is the realistic place to eat, so pack a picnic for trail days.

eats.name: Randy's at The Chuckwagon
eats.what_to_order: Full breakfast until 11 AM, then lunch; the Torrey town page lists the deli's Reubens and chicken salad sandwiches.
eats.why: An early, simple breakfast-and-lunch counter on Torrey's Main Street, handy for a Capitol Reef start or for a picnic lunch.
eats.hours_note: Open 7 AM-3 PM daily; breakfast served until 11 AM.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists 7 AM-3 PM daily hours and a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Broken Spur Inn & Steakhouse
eats.what_to_order: Hand-cut steaks; the page mentions the ribeye, sirloin and St. Louis ribs.
eats.why: Torrey's sit-down steakhouse about five minutes from Capitol Reef, per the town's own listing.
eats.hours_note: Dinner 4:30-10:00 PM daily from early March through mid-November; breakfast 7-10 AM daily, free for hotel guests and $12.99 for non-guests.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists seasonal dinner hours and a 2025 guest review (viewed 2026-10-03); the page carries no 2026 date.

eats.name: Moab Diner
eats.what_to_order: Sourdough French toast or a steak burrito, per Visit Utah.
eats.why: A retro diner on Main Street with an ice cream shop attached, serving diner food until 9 PM, so it covers both a pre-Arches breakfast and a late dinner.
eats.hours_note: Moab Happenings' restaurant guide lists Mon-Sat 6 AM-9 PM and closed Sundays; the venue's own site could not be fetched, so confirm before going.
eats.open_evidence: Visit Utah's Moab restaurants page lists it with a current description (viewed 2026-10-03); that page is undated, and the Moab Happenings guide independently lists its hours.

eats.name: Milt's Stop & Eat
eats.what_to_order: Per Visit Utah, the loaded Cowboy Burger, onion rings and a chocolate milkshake.
eats.why: Moab's oldest restaurant, first opened in September 1954 by Milt Galbraith, per its own site.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 11 AM to close, between 7 PM and 9 PM depending on the season.
eats.open_evidence: Own website says 'Celebrating 71 yrs in business! 1954 to 2025!' and lists current hours (viewed 2026-10-03).

eats.name: Red Iguana
eats.what_to_order: Any of its moles (the site lists Mole Negro, Amarillo, Poblano, Verde and more), plus the Killer Nachos.
eats.why: A Salt Lake City Mexican restaurant built around a long list of house moles, with two locations on the west side of downtown.
eats.hours_note: Sunday-Thursday 11 AM-9 PM; Friday and Saturday 11 AM-10 PM.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and the full mole menu, and cites a 2025 local-eats ranking (viewed 2026-10-03)

eats.name: Hires Big H
eats.what_to_order: A fresh-ground burger with fresh-cut fries, hand-dipped onion rings and the root beer the site calls 'Frosty'.
eats.why: A family-owned burger stand founded in 1959; the original location is at 425 S 700 E near downtown.
eats.hours_note: Closed Sundays; the site's pages give conflicting Friday and Saturday closing times, so confirm before going.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and describes the founding commitment 'over 66 years ago' (1959), with the original location listed (viewed 2026-10-03); the pages carry no explicit 2026 date.

eats.name: The Eating Establishment
eats.what_to_order: Huevos rancheros or the shakshuka skillet, both named in the magazine's listing.
eats.why: A Main Street fixture since 1972 serving comfort food and breakfast, which is rare longevity on a street that turns over fast.
eats.open_evidence: Park City Magazine's restaurant guide, updated May 27, 2026, lists it at 317 Main St (viewed 2026-10-03); its own site could not be fetched.

eats.name: No Name Saloon & Grill
eats.what_to_order: The buffalo burger the site bills as 'World Famous'.
eats.why: A Main Street saloon in a building that dates to 1905, known for its buffalo burger.
eats.hours_note: Monday-Friday 11 AM-1 AM, Saturday-Sunday 10 AM-1 AM; no reservations; guests must be 21 or older (under-21s are directed to the Annex Burger next door).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, menu and no-reservations policy (viewed 2026-10-03); the page carries no year.

eats.name: Bangkok Thai on Main
eats.what_to_order: Tom Kha Gai soup, Pad Thai, Kao Soi, Massaman Curry or Panang Curry, all named on the site.
eats.why: A Thai restaurant on Main Street open since 1994, which the site calls the only fine-dining Thai restaurant in Park City.
eats.hours_note: Own site lists 12-9 PM daily but a Park City restaurants listing shows different weekday hours, so confirm before going; reservations via Resy.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists hours, a menu and a Resy reservation link, and mentions additions 'this summer' (viewed 2026-10-03); the page carries no explicit year.

eats.name: August First Bakery & Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Freshly baked pastries and baked goods with coffee; breakfast is served all day.
eats.why: A bakery-cafe at 149 S. Champlain Street, about three blocks from Church Street, with indoor and outdoor seating and online pickup ordering.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 7:30am-3:00pm per its own site.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, online ordering and a footer reading 2025, with no 2026 year shown (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Stowe Bee Bakery & Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Morning pastries baked from scratch, lattes, and breakfast or lunch specials; cakes and pies can be ordered in advance.
eats.why: A bakery-cafe on Mountain Road in Stowe that bakes its pastries and cakes in-house.
eats.hours_note: Wednesday-Saturday 7am-5pm, Sunday 7am-2pm; closed Monday and Tuesday (per its own site, which says menus change seasonally).
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows current hours, online ordering and a footer reading 2026 (viewed 2026-10-15); one menu PDF linked there is labelled Winter 2023-2024.

eats.name: Café on Main
eats.what_to_order: Breakfast (served daily 7:30-10:45am), lunch and baked goods.
eats.why: A cafe at 38 Main Street in Stowe village that is open seven days a week.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 7:30am-3:15pm; breakfast served daily 7:30-10:45am.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and online ordering with a footer reading 2026 (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Craftsbury General Store (The Genny)
eats.what_to_order: Deli and bakery sandwiches, pizzas and to-go meals; the store also pours kombucha on tap.
eats.why: The village general store on South Craftsbury Road in Craftsbury Common, with a deli and bakery counter, run by a local group that also operates a second store in Albany.
eats.hours_note: Per its own site: store Mon-Sat 7am-7pm, Sun 9am-7pm; deli closed Monday, open Sun/Tue/Wed 10am-2pm and Thu-Sat 10am-7pm. That page shows no year, and another guide lists longer food hours, so confirm before relying on the deli.
eats.open_evidence: Own blog shows posts dated through Nov 28, 2025; Seven Days (Mar 12, 2025) describes the deli-bakery as open and operating; own hours page viewed 2026-10-15 shows no year.

eats.name: Down Home Comfort Bakery
eats.what_to_order: The cinnamon rolls, which the bakery's own page calls "famous", made with homemade brown sugar and house-made cream cheese frosting, or the pecan sticky buns.
eats.why: A two-owner, scratch-baking shop on Front Royal's Main Street, a handy pastry stop on the way into Skyline Drive.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: closed Monday; Tuesday, Thursday-Saturday 9am-6pm; Wednesday 9am-12pm; Sunday 9am-4pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer, a posted weekly hours table and customer reviews dated March-June 2024 (viewed 2026-10-15).

stops.note: Per the NPS operating-hours page (last updated 2026-09-22), Shenandoah's concession dining is seasonal in 2026: Elkwallow Wayside April 29 to November 8, Skyland March 30 to November 8, Big Meadows Lodge May 4 to November 29. The NPS adds that concessionaire hours vary and points to the concessionaire's website for current hours. Our advice: check those hours before relying on a meal on Skyline Drive after November 8, and carry water and a lunch for the overlooks.

eats.name: Main Street Bakery & Catering
eats.what_to_order: Quiches, cinnamon rolls, muffins and pastries; the site also says lunch is served daily.
eats.why: A downtown Luray bakery open since December 2003 and run by Chef Chuck Arnaud, per a Page Valley News profile.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: Tuesday-Friday 8am-5pm, Saturday 8am-3pm; the 2023 Page Valley News profile also says closed Sunday and Monday.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer and current hours (viewed 2026-10-15); a Page Valley News profile (published 2023-12-07) marks 20 years in business.

stops.note: Per the NPS operating-hours page (last updated 2026-09-22), in-park dining on Skyline Drive in 2026 runs: Elkwallow Wayside April 29 to November 8, Skyland March 30 to November 8, Big Meadows Lodge May 4 to November 29, with concessionaire hours varying. Our advice: for the Hawksbill Loop Trail day, eat in Luray before or after rather than counting on a park meal, and note that only one Luray place is verified here.

eats.name: Rudee's Restaurant & Cabana Bar
eats.what_to_order: Seafood; the site describes fresh seafood delivered daily and also lists a Sunday brunch menu.
eats.why: Right on the Rudee Inlet marina, the spot the itinerary's "seafood dinner near Rudee Inlet" points to, with glider tables over the water and a restaurant open since 1983 per its own site.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: closed only on Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day; Sunday brunch 10am-2pm; the outdoor cabana bar and deck dining are weather permitting, so call 757-425-1777. The site's Monday-Thursday hours line is garbled ("11:00pm - 8:00pm"), so confirm by phone.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer, posted hours and a hiring notice (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Waterman's Surfside Grille
eats.what_to_order: Seafood and the Original Orange Crush, the cocktail the restaurant says it brought to the oceanfront.
eats.why: A family-run oceanfront restaurant (Standing family) that has been in the same building since 1981 and buys under the Sensible Seafood program, per its own About page.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: Monday-Thursday 11am-10pm, Friday-Saturday 11am-10:30pm, Sunday 9am-10pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer, posted hours, and a reservations policy that it says is updated monthly (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Berret's Seafood Restaurant and Taphouse Grill
eats.what_to_order: The October dinner special listed on its specials page for October 15-16: herb-crusted triggerfish fillet and buttery shrimp with creamy rice, asparagus and basil-butter sauce; the site also advertises $1 oysters daily 11:30am-6pm.
eats.why: A Merchants Square seafood restaurant open since 1983, in a former gas station, one block from the Historic Area.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: open daily 11:30am-8:30pm; reservations are for indoor dining only, outdoor seating is first-come first-served; the $1 oyster deal excludes special days.
eats.open_evidence: Own website specials page lists dinner specials for Thursday October 15 and Friday October 16 (weekdays that match 2026) and an events page lists October live music; viewed 2026-10-15.

eats.name: The Cheese Shop
eats.what_to_order: The Cheese Shop sandwich, made to order on bread baked daily, such as the roast beef & cheese or the country ham & cheese.
eats.why: A Merchants Square shop run by the Power family since 1971, per the Merchants Square directory, handy for a picnic lunch near the Historic Area.
eats.hours_note: Per its site, sandwiches are served Tuesday-Saturday 10am-6pm and Sunday 11am-6pm; the Merchants Square directory lists Monday as closed.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a sandwich price list and hours with a 2024 copyright footer; the Merchants Square directory (2025 copyright, 2026 events listed) lists it with matching hours; viewed 2026-10-15. The venue's own page has no 2025 or 2026 date.

eats.name: Riverwalk Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: Per Coastal Virginia magazine: the Shrimp Givesti (inspired by Nick's Seafood Pavilion's original), the Riverwalk Burger with a house-made crabcake, or the Seafood Mac & Cheese.
eats.why: A York River waterfront restaurant on Water Street that reopened in May 2024 under a local owner who also runs Water Street Grille and Waypoint Seafood.
eats.hours_note: Per its site: Wednesday-Thursday 4-8pm, Friday-Saturday 4-9pm, Sunday 4-8pm; no Monday or Tuesday hours are listed.
eats.open_evidence: Own website events page lists a Halloween fundraiser and a Thanksgiving buffet on Thursday, November 26, 2026 with reservations open (viewed 2026-10-15); Coastal Virginia magazine (2024-07-01) reports the May 2024 reopening.

eats.name: Mobjack Coffee Roasters & Petite Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Per York County Tourism: the Mobjack Reuben Panini (pastrami, homemade dressing and slaw on rye), the Farmer's BLT, or the Curry Chickpea Salad Wrap.
eats.why: A small cafe in a white-washed brick building on Historic Main Street, in the old village near the battlefield rather than down on the waterfront.
eats.hours_note: Per its site banner: open every day; Sunday 9am-5pm, Monday-Thursday 9am-4pm, Friday 9am-5pm, Saturday 8am-5pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows a 2026 copyright footer, a daily hours banner, a Petite Cafe menu link and the 411 Main Street address (viewed 2026-10-15); York County Tourism's Culinary Delights page (undated) describes the cafe menu.

eats.name: Pike Place Chowder
eats.what_to_order: The chowders, which its own page describes as award-winning and made with certified sustainable seafood.
eats.why: A two-location Seattle business whose flagship is at 1530 Post Alley inside Pike Place Market, right on the Day 1 market stop.
eats.hours_note: Pike Place Market location: daily 11 AM to 5 PM per its locations page.
eats.open_evidence: Own locations page lists the Pike Place Market hours and carries a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Mee Sum Pastry
eats.what_to_order: Hom bows (BBQ pork, chicken, curried beef or vegetarian) or the BBQ pork-on-a-stick.
eats.why: A family-run hom bow and dim sum counter inside Pike Place Market; the Pike Place Market page names owners Jack and Melissa Fong.
eats.hours_note: Open daily 8am to 6:30pm per the Pike Place Market vendor page.
eats.open_evidence: Pike Place Market's vendor page lists current daily hours, has a 2026 copyright footer and blog posts dated through June 2026 (viewed 2026-10-14).

stops.note: Per the National Park Service (page last updated December 2024), the National Park Inn at Longmire has a restaurant serving breakfast, lunch and dinner that is "the only in-park dining facility that is open all year"; the Paradise Inn restaurant and cafe "are open only from May to early October"; and the Sunrise Day Lodge snack bar is usually open July through September. Our advice: for Day 1, eat in Ashford rather than counting on food at Paradise, especially outside summer.

eats.name: Copper Creek Inn Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: The house-made blackberry pie, which the page calls a signature item, or the cinnamon rolls called Copper Toppers.
eats.why: On the road to the Nisqually entrance in Ashford, it has operated as a restaurant since 1946 according to Visit Rainier.
eats.hours_note: Per Visit Rainier: open year-round; Monday and Thursday 11am-6pm, Friday to Sunday 11am-7pm, closed Tuesday and Wednesday.
eats.open_evidence: Visit Rainier's restaurant page lists current weekly hours and a 2026 copyright, and the inn's own site (also 2026 copyright) names the blackberry pie; the own site does not list hours (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Wildberry Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: A Himalayan (Nepalese) special or one of the Summit Burgers, both named on its own page.
eats.why: Family-run place in Ashford pairing American mountain fare with a Himalayan specials menu; its page credits owners Angdawa and Lhakpa Gelu Sherpa.
eats.hours_note: Seasonal: open May through October each year, and no exact closing date is stated. Hours: Friday to Tuesday 12pm-8pm, Wednesday 12pm-7:30pm, closed Thursday; last dine-in order 7:30pm. Call ahead near the end of October.
eats.open_evidence: Own website says it is "NOW open for the 2026 season" and lists current hours (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Domini Sandwiches
eats.what_to_order: A deli sandwich such as the Reuben, pastrami or roast beef; the site says the menu is basic, with house-roasted meats and fresh-baked bread.
eats.why: A downtown Spokane sandwich shop that dates to 1963; per the Inlander (November 2024) the owner retired and passed it to longtime employees.
eats.hours_note: Monday to Friday 10am-2:30pm, closed Saturday and Sunday (own website, no year shown).
eats.open_evidence: Spokesman-Review (23 September 2026) lists it among current Spokane eats as reopened in 2025 under new ownership; own site lists Monday-Friday hours but shows no year (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Cottage Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Chicken fried steak and eggs (per the Spokesman-Review); the cafe's own site says clam chowder is served on Fridays in fall and winter.
eats.why: In the neighbouring city of Spokane Valley rather than Spokane itself; a one-location breakfast and lunch cafe open daily.
eats.hours_note: Open 7 days a week 7am-2pm; closed Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day, closes early on their eves, opens 8am on New Year's Day (own website).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and links a menu file named for 2026, and the Spokesman-Review of 23 September 2026 lists it with 7 AM-2 PM daily hours (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Riptide Waterfront Cafe
eats.what_to_order: An island-inspired breakfast sandwich with locally roasted coffee or espresso, or a fresh-baked pastry.
eats.why: A waterfront cafe at 10 Front Street in Friday Harbor that has served the island since 2016, a quick breakfast after the Day 2 ferry crossing.
eats.hours_note: Seasonal hours: the homepage says open 7am to 2pm every day, but its footer says 7am to 5pm daily; the page says it is open for the season.
eats.open_evidence: Own website carries a 2026 copyright and says it is open for the season (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Bakery San Juan
eats.what_to_order: Sourdough pizza by the slice, sourdough bread or a sandwich; the page also lists breakfast pastries and pies.
eats.why: An island bakery in Friday Harbor, established 2008, baking sourdough breads and pizzas.
eats.hours_note: Monday to Friday 8am-5pm, closed Saturday and Sunday (own website, no year shown).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu with no seasonal closure notice, but the page shows no year (copyright line has no date); weaker evidence than a dated page (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Orcas Bakery
eats.what_to_order: Handmade sourdough bread and baked goods; the page names no specific items beyond that.
eats.why: Daily alternative to Brown Bear Baking, which is closed Tuesday to Thursday; the page says it bakes sourdough with local Pacific Northwest ingredients.
eats.hours_note: Open every day 8am-3pm per its own website; the Orcas Island Chamber food and drink guide (undated) also lists daily 8am-3pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists daily hours and the Orcas Island Chamber of Commerce guide agrees, but neither shows a year; weaker evidence than a dated page (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: The Lower Tavern
eats.what_to_order: A burger (Best Burger, Black & Bleu, Patty Melt or Salmon Burger are named) or fish & chips.
eats.why: A sports tavern at 46 Prune Alley in Eastsound that serves a full kitchen daily; it is one of three local restaurants under the same ownership alongside Blackfish Cafe and Harbor Bar & Grill.
eats.hours_note: Kitchen 11AM-10PM daily; bar open until 2AM (own website).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current kitchen hours and carries a 2026 copyright (viewed 2026-10-14).

stops.note: The National Park Service says New River Gorge National Park & Preserve has no dining facilities inside its boundaries and that restaurants are in gateway towns including Fayetteville, Beckley, Oak Hill and Mount Hope. Our advice: eat in Fayetteville and carry a picnic for trail and rafting days (the NPS notes picnicking is allowed throughout most of the park).

eats.name: Secret Sandwich Society
eats.what_to_order: Sandwiches named for U.S. presidents, such as the Kennedy (slow-cooked pork shoulder, ham, Swiss), per LongWeekends Magazine, Spring/Summer 2025.
eats.why: Fayetteville's presidential-themed sandwich shop, rebuilt and reopened in 2023 on Keller Avenue after a 2020 fire, with a beer garden.
eats.hours_note: Own site lists Fayetteville hours as Sunday-Thursday 11am-9pm and Friday-Saturday 11am-10pm (the page shows no year).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours for the Fayetteville location (page shows no year); LongWeekends Magazine's Spring/Summer 2025 issue describes the rebuilt restaurant as open on Keller Avenue (viewed 2026-10-15). Operates three locations (Fayetteville, Morgantown, Richmond).

eats.name: Bridge Brew Works
eats.what_to_order: Locally brewed craft beer by the pint or as a tasting flight, per the brewery's own site.
eats.why: A small local taproom in Fayetteville, a short stop from the New River Gorge Bridge.
eats.hours_note: Taproom hours listed as Tuesday-Sunday 1pm-9pm, closed Monday; the site labels these hours 'March-December'. The page does not mention a food menu.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows taproom hours and a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-15).

stops.note: The National Park Service says there are no eating or lodging establishments inside Harpers Ferry National Historical Park; all eating, lodging and shopping is just outside the park boundaries in the towns of Harpers Ferry and Bolivar. Our advice: eat in the Lower Town and bring water and snacks for the Maryland Heights hike.

eats.name: The Rabbit Hole GastroPub
eats.what_to_order: Burgers, sandwiches or Fish and Chips from the main plates, per the venue's menu page.
eats.why: A locally run gastropub on High Street in Harpers Ferry with indoor and outdoor seating.
eats.hours_note: Home page showed 'open today 12:00 pm - 8:00 pm' when viewed; closed annually January 5-15 for maintenance and training; special holiday hours (Halloween, Christmas Eve, New Year's Eve).
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows today's hours and a 2026 closure notice for January 5-15, plus a current menu page with prices (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Abolitionist Ale Works
eats.what_to_order: Its own house-brewed beers; the site says food and beverage menus are available.
eats.why: A local brewery in downtown Charles Town, close to the Jefferson County Museum.
eats.hours_note: Tuesday-Thursday 4-9pm, Friday-Saturday noon-9pm, Sunday noon-8pm (closed Monday per the listed hours).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and has a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Scaturo's Baking Co. & Cafe
eats.what_to_order: The Fisherman's Breakfast, BLT Benedict or The Ultimate Door County Burger from the cafe menu, plus baked goods from the bakery counter.
eats.why: A bakery and cafe in Sturgeon Bay where the website says all bakery items are made fresh daily, which makes it a practical first stop before heading up the peninsula.
eats.hours_note: Per its own site: Monday-Friday 5:00am-4:00pm dining (bakery/takeout until 7:00pm), Saturday 5:00am-3:00pm, Sunday 7:00am-2:00pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website footer reads 2025 and its menu links are titled april-2026 and august-2026; hours listed (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: White Gull Inn
eats.what_to_order: The traditional Door County fish boil, featuring Lake Michigan whitefish.
eats.why: The inn says it has operated continuously since 1896 and serves the fish boil, a Door County tradition, to the general public.
eats.hours_note: Per its own site, fish boils are served Wednesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday with seatings at 5:00, 6:30 and 8:00 PM; reservations recommended, call (920) 868-3517.
eats.open_evidence: Own website describes year-round service and its navigation lists 'Winter Concerts 2026-2027' (viewed 2026-10-15); the page shows no copyright footer year.

eats.name: Pelletier's Fish Creek
eats.what_to_order: The Door County fish boil at night, or the daily breakfast and lunch menus (the page links the menus but lists no individual dishes).
eats.why: A Main Street Fish Creek restaurant that does a fish boil every night and serves breakfast and lunch daily, so it covers a morning meal in the town.
eats.hours_note: Per its own site: breakfast and lunch daily 7:30 am-2:00 pm; fish boil nightly at 5, 6 and 7 pm (8 pm during peak season). The site states the last day of service for the 2026 season is Sunday, October 25.
eats.open_evidence: Own website says 'Our last day of service for the 2026 Season will be Sunday, October 25th' and lists current hours (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Al Johnson's Swedish Restaurant & Butik
eats.what_to_order: Swedish pancakes with lingonberries, strawberries or maple syrup, or the Swedish meatballs.
eats.why: The Sister Bay restaurant with live goats grazing on its sod roof; its site says Swedish pancakes are served all day.
eats.hours_note: Per its own site: restaurant 7:00am-3:00pm. The site says the roof goats usually stay from late May through mid-October and stay off the roof in rain or snow.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and menu with a page timestamp of 2026-09-08 (its footer still reads 2021), and WBAY/WSAW news reported on 2026-06-24 that the restaurant's Goat Cam was relaunched (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Jackson Harbor Soup
eats.what_to_order: Grammy's Potato Soup, Beer & Cheddar Soup or a panini; The Welcome Basket lets you pick 2 of 3 of soup, salad and sandwich.
eats.why: A casual lunch stop at the Jackson Harbor end of the island, near the Rock Island ferry dock according to the island chamber of commerce.
eats.hours_note: Per its own site: lunch Thursday-Monday 11:00 am-3:00 pm, closed Tuesday and Wednesday. The page does not state when the 2026 season ends; call 920-847-2589 before going in late October.
eats.open_evidence: Own website shows 'Season 11 - 2026', current hours and a footer reading (c) 2026 (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Red Cup Coffee House
eats.what_to_order: Organic Fair Trade coffee, espresso drinks, smoothies and gourmet pastries or egg sandwiches.
eats.why: Listed by Travel Wisconsin as open year around, one of few island spots not tied to the summer season.
eats.hours_note: Travel Wisconsin states it is open year around; no hours are given on the pages fetched, so call 920-847-3304.
eats.open_evidence: Travel Wisconsin (state tourism) listing says open year around, and the Washington Island Chamber of Commerce site (footer 2026) lists it with the owner family; neither page carries venue-specific dates (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Milwaukee Public Market
eats.what_to_order: Cheese curds, ready-to-eat meals and the market's bars; the site names no individual dishes, so check merchants on arrival.
eats.why: A Historic Third Ward food hall with 19 independently owned merchants, so it suits a mixed group on the Third Ward day.
eats.hours_note: Per its own site: Monday-Friday 10am-8pm, Saturday 10am-8pm, Sunday 10am-6pm; individual merchants may keep different hours.
eats.open_evidence: Own website footer reads 'Copyright © 2026 Milwaukee Public Market' and lists current hours, with no closure notice (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Kopp's Frozen Custard
eats.what_to_order: The flavor of the day; the site's October 15, 2026 listing named Strawberry and Pralines 'N Caramel 'N Cream, a Butterfinger Shake of the Month and a Caramel Apple Sundae of the Month.
eats.why: In the Milwaukee suburbs of Glendale, Greenfield and Brookfield rather than downtown; a three-location local custard stand that publishes its flavor of the day.
eats.hours_note: Per its own site, all three locations: Sunday-Thursday 10:30am-10:00pm, Friday and Saturday 10:30am-11:00pm; no seasonal closure notice on the page.
eats.open_evidence: Own website footer reads 2026 and lists flavors and monthly specials dated October 15, 2026 (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Monty's Blue Plate Diner
eats.what_to_order: Breakfast, which the site says is served all day; the site also lists sandwiches, soups and salads with vegetarian and vegan options.
eats.why: A Schenk-Atwood neighborhood diner a short drive east of the Capitol that serves breakfast all day, handy on a day that starts at the Dane County Farmers' Market or the gardens.
eats.hours_note: Per its own site: open every day 7:30am-9:00pm (an Isthmus listing gives slightly different hours, so confirm before going).
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours and online ordering (no year shown); Cap Times Madison Burger Week 2026 article dated 2026-05-15 lists Monty's Mediterranean Smash Burger at 2089 Atwood Ave (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Dane County Farmers' Market (Saturday on the Square)
eats.what_to_order: Whatever the producers have that morning; the page names no specific foods.
eats.why: The Saturday market ringing the Capitol Square is a producer-only market, and it is the listed activity on the Madison gardens and campus day.
eats.hours_note: Per its own site: Saturdays April 11 through November 14, 2026, 6:15 am-1:45 pm (1:00 pm close on September 5); vendors may sell out early. Only operates on Saturdays.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists the 2026 season dates and a footer reading (c) 2026 (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Riverview Terrace Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Sandwiches, salads and ice cream; the page describes comfort classics with local ingredients but names no individual dishes.
eats.why: The cafe is at Frank Lloyd Wright's Taliesin visitor center, so it fits a Taliesin tour day without a drive into town.
eats.hours_note: Per its own site: breakfast 9:00-11:00 AM, lunch 11:00 AM-3:00 PM; open daily May 1-October 31, then Wednesday-Sunday November 1-April 30; no reservations. The page states no year for this schedule.
eats.open_evidence: Taliesin Preservation's homepage links 2026 news (dated September 29, 2026) and lists the cafe as 'Mon - Sun: 9am - 3pm'; the cafe page's schedule carries no year, and the footer shows no year (viewed 2026-10-15).

eats.name: Spring Green General Store
eats.what_to_order: Soups, weekend pancake specials, cinnamon twists and vegetarian options; weekend breakfast is served 8 am-noon.
eats.why: A cafe and shop in the village of Spring Green itself, with a menu the site describes as old-school comfort food, useful when the tours are done.
eats.hours_note: Per its own site: Tuesday-Friday 10 am-3 pm, Saturday and Sunday 8 am-3 pm, closed Monday; kitchen closes at 2 pm. The owner's 2026 notice says the store is for sale and continues operating while a buyer is sought, so ownership may change.
eats.open_evidence: Own website carries a 2026 owner notice that the store is for sale after 33 years and 'continues operating', with current hours (viewed 2026-10-15).

stops.note: The NPS lists 2026 in-park dining dates of May 1 to October 12 for the Old Faithful Inn Dining Room and Bear Paw Deli, May 15 to October 25 for the Canyon Lodge Eatery and Lounge, and April 17 to October 31 (then December 15 to March 15) for the Old Faithful Snow Lodge Geyser Grill, and says all dates are subject to change without advance notice. Our advice: the eats below are in and around Jackson, not inside Yellowstone, so on the Lamar Valley, Canyon and Old Faithful days check the NPS dates for the year you travel and bring your own lunch.

eats.name: The Bunnery Bakery & Restaurant
eats.what_to_order: Breakfast or lunch plus items from the bakery, which the site says is fresh daily; the page names no individual dishes.
eats.why: A bakery-restaurant at 130 N. Cache Street, half a block from Town Square, so it works as a breakfast stop before a Teton day.
eats.hours_note: Site lists breakfast 7:00-11:30 and lunch 11:30-3:00; no dinner service is listed on the page.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists breakfast and lunch hours and carries a 2026 copyright footer (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Persephone Bakery & Cafe
eats.what_to_order: Pastries, bread and coffee; the site says the coffee comes from local Jackson Hole Roasters.
eats.why: A Jackson Hole bakery group with three sites (Persephone Jackson, Persephone Westbank and Picnic) that says its food is sourced from over 20 regional farms and ranches.
eats.hours_note: Site says all cafes are open daily; the page fetched gives no hours.
eats.open_evidence: Own website says 'ALL CAFES ARE NOW OPEN DAILY', offers online ordering and carries a 'Copyright 2026' footer (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Nora's Fish Creek Inn
eats.what_to_order: Huevos Rancheros, which the site calls the restaurant's famous dish; breakfast is served all day.
eats.why: In the neighbouring town of Wilson rather than Jackson itself. A single-location restaurant that serves breakfast, lunch and dinner seven days a week, with daily dinner specials such as Prime Rib and Fish 'n Chips.
eats.hours_note: Site lists open 7 days a week: breakfast 6:30am-2pm, lunch 11am-2pm, dinner 5pm-9pm. The site's page title reads 'Nora's Homestyle Kitchen & Bar' while its logo and footer say 'Nora's Fish Creek Inn'.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current hours, daily dinner specials and a live-music schedule, with a 2026 copyright footer and no closure or seasonal notice (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: Ranch Eats Cafe
eats.what_to_order: The rotating daily menu; the Wyoming Tribune Eagle article mentions broccoli cheese soup, pulled pork quesadillas, the Cowboy Meets Alien Burger and pastries baked fresh daily.
eats.why: A downtown cafe at 1920 Thomes Ave inside the City Center Building that grew out of a 2022 food truck and uses local beef and Josie's Creamery ice cream, per the Wyoming Tribune Eagle.
eats.hours_note: Own site lists Monday-Friday 8am-2pm (the June 2025 opening article said weekdays from 7am); closed weekends per that article.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists current cafe hours and online ordering but its footer reads 'Copyright 2024'; Wyoming Tribune Eagle article on the downtown opening dated June 3, 2025 (page shows an update of July 9, 2026) (viewed 2026-10-14).

eats.name: The Albany Restaurant, Bar & Liquor Mart
eats.what_to_order: Hand-cut steaks and slow-roasted meats; the Chamber listing says soups, gravies, salad dressings and specials are made from scratch.
eats.why: A family-owned downtown restaurant and bar at 1506 Capitol Ave that Cheyenne's tourism board lists as opened in 1942.
eats.hours_note: Chamber listing: restaurant 11am-2pm lunch and 5pm-9pm dinner; closed Sundays. The listing carries no year, so confirm by phone, (307) 638-3507.
eats.open_evidence: Cheyenne Chamber of Commerce member listing gives current hours and phone, and the Cheyenne tourism board's local-eats page lists it as family owned; neither page shows a year, so this is weaker evidence (viewed 2026-10-14).
eats.source_name: Cheyenne Chamber of Commerce member listing

stops.note: The NPS says there are no restaurants or food options inside Devils Tower National Monument; Hulett is 10 miles north and Sundance 30 miles southeast, and Devils Tower View, one mile south of the monument, is open year round with a small restaurant (page last updated April 24, 2025).

eats.name: Longhorn Saloon & Grill
eats.what_to_order: Steak; the site calls it a steakhouse serving the best cuts of local beef.
eats.why: A family-run steakhouse at 214 Main in Sundance, run by Charity and Josh McLaughlin, and called Etta's Place until it was renamed in 2013, per the Sundance Times.
eats.hours_note: Own site lists open daily 11am-9pm.
eats.open_evidence: Own website lists daily hours but shows only a 2022 copyright; Sundance Times of Aug 21, 2025 reports the owners and a filming date at the restaurant, and its March 26, 2026 legal notice lists Longhorn Saloon & Grill, LLC applying to renew its 2026/2027 liquor license (viewed 2026-10-14).
